title: Medior/Senior Softwareontwikkelaar (TypeScript) (m/v/x)
description:
Over ons bedrijf 

Zelf weer controle krijgen over je eigen data. Dat is de missie van stichting Nederlandse Datakluis. Wij ontwikkelen software waarmee mensen zelf bepalen welke data ze opslaan in hun persoonlijke datakluis, wat ze delen, met wie en waarom. Geen tracking, geen dataslurpers, geen ondoorzichtige voorwaarden. Gewoon: autonomie over je eigen digitale leven. We gebruiken de open standaard Solid, bedacht door sir Tim Berners-Lee himself. We zijn een groeiend team van idealisten, denkers en doeners met een sterke missie. We zijn in korte tijd koploper geworden in deze revolutionaire technologie die de basis gaat leggen voor persoonlijke AI-assistenten. Onze aanpak? Gestart vanuit een samenwerking met de grootste Nederlandse mediabedrijven rollen we eind van het jaar onze software uit op de grootste websites van Nederland en bouwen vanuit daar verder naar andere sectoren en andere toepassingen. Ons doel? Digitale autonomie voor miljoenen mensen met een eerlijker internet als resultaat. 

Missie 

Wij vinden dat het internet kapot is: en dat het anders kan. Wij geven mensen controle over hun persoonlijke data, zodat die data niet langer enkel waarde oplevert voor grote platformen en advertentienetwerken, maar vooral mensen zelf. Onze missie is om een infrastructuur te bouwen waarin vertrouwen, transparantie en menselijke regie centraal staan. Daarmee creëren we ruimte voor eerlijke markten, inclusieve digitale diensten en persoonlijke AI-oplossingen die werken vóór mensen, niet over hen heen. We willen zoveel mogelijk Nederlanders een persoonlijke datakluis geven en deze laten benutten voor zoveel mogelijk toepassingen. Dit is meer dan een product. Dit is de start van een beweging.

Taken

Jouw rol 

Wij zoeken een medior of senior softwareontwikkelaar met sterke TypeScript-vaardigheden. Je werkt mee aan de ontwikkeling van moderne webapplicaties en APIs waarbij privacybescherming en veilige identiteitsoplossingen centraal staan. Kennis van of interesse in OIDC (OpenID Connect) en/of Solid is een duidelijke pre.

Wat je gaat doen 

- Ontwikkelen en onderhouden van frontend- en backendtoepassingen in TypeScript.

- Ontwerpen en implementeren van veilige authenticatie- en autorisatiestromen (bijv. met OIDC/Solid).

- Meedenken over architectuurkeuzes en best practices.

- Schrijven van heldere, onderhoudbare code en bijdragen aan code reviews.

- Samenwerken met UX-designers, productmanagers en andere developers.

- Signaleren en implementeren van verbeteringen met oog voor privacy by design .

Vereisten

Jij brengt mee 

Must-have:

- Minimaal 3 jaar ervaring als softwareontwikkelaar (voor medior) of 5+ jaar (voor senior).

- Uitstekende kennis van TypeScript en moderne webtechnologieën.

- Ervaring met frameworks zoals React, Node.js of vergelijkbaar.

- Begrip van authenticatie- en autorisatieconcepten; ervaring met OIDC en/of Solid is een pre.

- Affiniteit met privacybescherming en veilig omgaan met persoonsgegevens.

- Goede beheersing van Nederlands en Engels.

Nice-to-have:

Interesse in, of ervaring met:

- Ervaring met Kubernetes of andere container-orchestrationplatforms (bijv. Docker Swarm, OpenShift).

- Ervaring met Agile softwareontwikkeling (Scrum / Kanban).

- Affiniteit met ethische technologie en digitale burgerrechten .

Benefits

Werk aan een eerlijke digitale toekomst – vanaf dag één impact maken 

Bij Stichting Nederlandse Datakluis werken we aan een van de meest baanbrekende digitale innovaties van dit moment: jouw•id , een persoonlijke datakluis waarmee mensen zelf regie krijgen over hun online identiteit en data. Geen tracking, geen verborgen voorwaarden, maar wél gebruiksgemak, veiligheid en transparantie.

Wat wij bieden 

- Een baan met betekenis : je werkt aan technologie die digitale autonomie teruggeeft aan mensen.

- Een marktconform salaris en een bijdrage aan je pensioenvoorziening.

- Mogelijkheid om deel te nemen in een medewerkersparticipatieprogramma .

- Samenwerking in een missiegedreven team van developers, designers, denkers maar bovenal doeners.

- Een hybride werkomgeving : deels remote, deels op onze mooie plek in het centrum van Utrecht.

- Flexibele werktijden (4 of 5 dagen per week).

- De kans om te leren van en te werken met technologieën die de toekomst van het web vormgeven (zoals Solid ).

- Een rol in een project dat door de EU wordt ondersteund en waar ook Sir Tim Berners-Lee warm van wordt.

Klaar voor impact? 

- Stuur je CV en een korte motivatie via deze site. Laat ons weten wat jou aanspreekt in deze rol en wat jij komt brengen.

- Ken je iemand anders voor wie deze rol geknipt is? Delen wordt gewaardeerd.

- Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature stellen we niet op prijs.

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an experienced SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist to develop, execute, and optimize digital marketing strategies that increase organic traffic, improve search rankings, generate qualified leads, and drive measurable business growth.

The ideal candidate has strong expertise in technical SEO, Google Ads, paid social advertising, content optimization, marketing analytics, and automation . This is a hands-on role requiring someone who can independently manage campaigns, identify growth opportunities, and turn marketing data into actionable strategies.

You’ll take ownership of organic search performance, paid advertising, website optimization, and lead generation while exploring emerging opportunities in AI-powered search optimization (AEO/GEO) .

Key Responsibilities 

SEO Strategy & Optimization 

- Develop and execute SEO strategies to improve organic visibility, keyword rankings, and website traffic.
- Conduct keyword research, competitor analysis, and search intent analysis.
- Perform technical SEO audits, addressing indexing, crawling, site architecture, page speed, and mobile performance.

- Execute ethical link-building strategies and monitor search algorithm updates.
- Optimize content for traditional search engines and AI-powered search experiences (AEO/GEO).
Paid Advertising & Lead Generation

What a Typical Day Looks Like 

Your day may begin by reviewing GA4, Google Search Console, and advertising dashboards to evaluate traffic, keyword rankings, and lead generation performance. You’ll investigate SEO opportunities, optimize paid campaigns, update website content, or improve landing page conversions.

You may also configure marketing automation workflows, analyze campaign results, and collaborate with sales or development teams to implement improvements.

In short: You’ll manage SEO, paid advertising, analytics, and marketing automation to generate qualified leads and drive measurable business growth.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) 

Success in this role will be measured through:

- Organic Traffic Growth: Increase qualified organic website traffic.

description:
Headquarters: Australia 

URL: https://www.askablelabs.com/ 

We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want.

You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models.

Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week.

How it works 

- Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume.

- Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate.

- Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks.

- Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them.

- Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it.

- Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round.

- Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another.

Requirements 

- 2+ years of professional software engineering

- Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code)

- Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++

Nice to have

Terms

title: AI/ML Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI/ML Engineer based in United Kingdom. 

Join a mission-driven engineering team developing practical AI systems that address real-world challenges in healthcare, agriculture, education, and international development. As an AI/ML Engineer, you will design, build, evaluate, deploy, and continuously improve AI-powered applications used by nonprofit organizations and their communities. You will work on solutions ranging from clinical copilots and AI coaching tools to agricultural advisory chatbots and evaluation infrastructure. Collaborating with behavioral scientists, researchers, and embedded engineers, you will translate applied AI research into reliable, scalable products and reusable technical resources. You will also help partner organizations strengthen their own AI capabilities through mentorship, open-source contributions, and knowledge sharing. This fully remote role offers substantial technical ownership and the opportunity to apply advanced AI engineering to initiatives that can improve outcomes for millions of people.

Accountabilities: 

In this role, you will build and improve production-ready AI systems while helping nonprofit partners adopt effective, measurable, and responsible AI practices. Your work will combine hands-on engineering, applied research, experimentation, and collaboration with teams working directly in the field.

- 
Design, build, evaluate, deploy, and improve machine learning systems and AI-powered applications for real-world use cases.

- 
Contribute to open-source AI evaluation infrastructure and tools that help nonprofit organizations assess and improve their AI products.

- 
Work closely with behavioral scientists, researchers, and field teams to identify recurring challenges and translate findings into reusable tools, frameworks, playbooks, and technical publications.

- 
Develop rigorous evaluation methods for AI systems, including appropriate datasets, evaluation criteria, and measurable performance improvements.

- 
Build and iterate on production-grade LLM applications and agentic systems, improving their reliability, usefulness, and performance for intended users.

- 
Release meaningful technical innovations from partner projects as open-source contributions whenever appropriate.

- 
Deliver solutions through rapid development and deployment cycles, using experimentation and measurable feedback to guide improvements.

- 
Document technical decisions, maintain engineering standards, and ensure AI components remain reliable and maintainable.

- 
Monitor developments in applied AI research, assess relevant advances, and test promising approaches in practical settings.

- 
Advise and support nonprofit organizations developing generative AI products, helping them adopt effective engineering practices, tools, and workflows.

- 
Mentor partner organization staff and help strengthen their internal technical capabilities and responsible AI practices.

- 
Contribute to workshops, seminars, and knowledge-sharing initiatives that communicate lessons and best practices from ongoing projects.

- 
Conduct site visits to understand operational challenges, observe how AI tools are used, and recommend technical improvements based on direct user needs.

- 
Take initiative in identifying problems, defining solutions, and driving projects through implementation and deployment.

Requirements: 

The ideal candidate combines strong machine learning fundamentals with substantial hands-on experience delivering end-user AI products. You should be comfortable moving between research, experimentation, production engineering, and collaboration with nontechnical stakeholders, while maintaining a strong focus on practical impact.

- 
Strong foundations in mathematics, deep learning, large language models (LLMs), and modern AI systems.

- 
At least 4 years of hands-on machine learning engineering experience, including building, evaluating, and systematically improving at least one end-user-facing product powered by deep learning. Experience limited to integrating model APIs, building internal dashboards, or contributing solely to ML infrastructure does not meet this requirement.

- 
At least 1–2 years of experience building LLM-powered applications, including at least one production-grade agent beyond a proof of concept.

- 
Practical experience evaluating AI systems, with a strong understanding of dataset design, evaluation methodology, and performance measurement.

- 
Proficiency in Python and a willingness to remain deeply involved in hands-on implementation.

- 
Fluency in prompting and context engineering for agentic systems, including the ability to determine whether a problem requires improved prompting, a different model, better tools, or changes to the overall pipeline.

- 
Experience using AI coding agents to produce high-quality work, with the judgment and accountability to validate outputs and take responsibility for what you ship.

- 
Ability to read research papers, assess new ideas, and quickly test relevant approaches through practical experimentation.

- 
An experimental mindset, with the ability to reason carefully about data, models, and evaluation while making iterative, measurable progress.

- 
Strong first-principles thinking and the ability to design practical, scalable solutions.

- 
A user-focused approach that prioritizes whether a product works effectively for its intended audience.

- 
Proactive ownership, urgency, attention to detail, and the ability to carry projects through to completion without constant direction.

- 
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to nonengineering audiences.

- 
A commitment to responsible AI development and technology that delivers meaningful social benefits.

Bonus qualifications: 

- 
Experience with multilingual natural language processing or low-resource languages, particularly Swahili, Hindi, and languages spoken across East Africa and South Asia.

- 
Previous work in global health, international development, or social-impact technology.

- 
Familiarity with behavioral science or AI applications designed to support behavior change.

- 
Experience with data annotation pipelines and LLM evaluation methodologies.

- 
Knowledge of AI safety, alignment, or responsible AI frameworks.

- 
Experience deploying models in production and working with cloud infrastructure such as AWS, Google Cloud Platform, or Azure.

- 
Publications at leading AI conferences or substantial technical writing documenting engineering research and results.

Benefits: 

- 
Compensation: Competitive within the mission-driven technology sector, with compensation positioned below typical big-tech salary levels.

- 
Remote work: Fully remote, asynchronous-first working environment.

- 
Flexible schedule: Work hours can accommodate your time zone, with no mandated core hours.

- 
International collaboration: Join a globally distributed team working across North America, Europe, East Africa, East Asia, and South Asia.

- 
Meaningful impact: Build AI applications addressing practical challenges in healthcare, agriculture, and other areas of international development.

- 
Technical ownership: Take projects from initial problem definition and model selection through deployment, evaluation, and continuous improvement.

- 
Interdisciplinary collaboration: Work alongside behavioral scientists, development economists, field researchers, and embedded engineers.

- 
Open-source contributions: Share technical innovations, tools, and learnings with the wider community rather than keeping all work within proprietary products.

- 
Professional development: Stay close to applied AI research and gain experience solving challenging problems in real operational environments.

- 
Autonomy and responsibility: Contribute within a small team with minimal hierarchy, direct feedback, and opportunities to influence technical decisions.

- 
Location eligibility: The role is open to candidates based in Sub-Saharan Africa and South Asia. India falls within the stated eligible regions, subject to the hiring team's location and contracting requirements.

-

title: Machine Learning Engineer - IV (Computer Vision)
description:
Headquarters: India (remote)

Machine Learning Engineer IV – (Computer Vision) 

We’re looking for a Staff/Senior Machine Learning Engineer with deep expertise in computer vision and biometrics to lead the design and scaling of face recognition systems in production. You’ll build and train models, and own ML systems end-to-end on AWS. The final job level for this role will be determined following the interview process.

What You’ll Do 

- Lead the design and development of computer vision systems for biometrics (face attributes, detection, quality, and recognition)

- Rigorous fairness analysis and benchmarking of biometric models across various datasets and operating conditions.

- Architect, train, and optimize models using PyTorch, Tensorflow, and/or JAX

- Own and evolve end-to-end ML pipelines, from data ingestion to deployment. Design automated pipelines (Airflow) for data ingestion and cleaning. You will be responsible for curating balanced training sets and generating synthetic data to address both quality and diversity gaps.

- Production Engineering: Own the path to production. Optimize models for low-latency inference (quantization, distillation, TensorRT/ONNX) and manage deployment on AWS.

- Mentor ML engineers, conduct code/design reviews, and drive technical best practices across the Computer Vision team.

What We’re Looking For 

- Strong industry experience in Machine Learning, dedicated to Biometrics or Face Analysis.

- Deep expertise in computer vision and biometrics, especially face recognition.

- Fairness & Ethics: You understand the sources of algorithmic bias in Computer Vision and have practical experience measuring and mitigating disparate impact.

- Strong Engineering: Expert proficiency in Python (both machine learning and vision libraries such as Pillow, OpenCV, PyTorch, etc). You write clean, modular, production-ready code.

- Systems Architecture: Experience designing end-to-end ML pipelines (Data to Train to Deploy) and working with workflow orchestrators like Airflow.

- Cloud Native: Hands-on experience scaling training jobs on multi-GPU clusters and deploying services on AWS (SageMaker, EC2, EKS).

Nice to Have 

- Research Publications: Papers in CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, or FG related to face recognition, image quality assessment, or fairness.

- Large Scale Search: Experience with vector databases (e.g., Milvus, Faiss) and approximate nearest neighbor (ANN) search algorithms.

- Familiarity with privacy, security, and compliance in biometric systems.

- Mobile/Edge Experience: Experience porting models to edge or mobile devices utilizing frameworks such as CoreML, LiteRT, and/or TFLite.

- Synthetic Data: Experience using GANs or diffusion models to generate synthetic faces for training.

- Strong communication skills.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
At Veriff 's Biometric Solutions team, we are trying to prove, in real time, that the person on the other side of the screen is real and who they claim to be. Our ML-powered platform uses advanced image recognition, facial verification, face recognition, facial anti-spoofing (liveness detection), and behavior analysis to make identity decisions. 

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to help build and scale our real-time verification services, with security, scalability, and maintainability at the core.

You'll help us protect honest people online by: 

- Owning the design and evolution of the architecture for a strategically critical product area, making the calls that shape scalability, security, and maintainability for years

- Leading transformational architecture work: real-time matching at scale, resilient event-driven services, and the CI/CD and observability foundations that make them dependable

- Setting and raising engineering standards, and mentoring and growing the engineers around you

- Partnering closely with other engineers, ML data scientists, and specialists to turn complex identity problems into working products, and driving cross-functional alignment with product and dependency teams

- Building scalable, maintainable APIs and event-driven services that other teams and external customers depend on

You are the right future Veriffian if you have 

- Over 5 years of experience building and operating large-scale applications (ideally in Python)

- Deep expertise in distributed systems, modular design, and SOLID principles, with a track record of architectural ownership

- Experience building scalable, maintainable APIs and working with message-queuing concepts

- Fluency with CI/CD, monitoring, and what it takes to run reliable, high-throughput services in production

- Comfort with a range of testing strategies for robust, reliable software

- A working understanding of relational databases and structured logging systems

- Strong communication and influencing skills, able to align engineers and non-engineers around a technical vision

- A self-starter mindset that balances both tech and product decisions to come up with a balanced outcome for both customers and engineers.

- A history of mentoring engineers and explaining your solutions to non-engineers

Nice to have: 

- Some experience working with mobile SDKs (iOS, Android) or Web in React

- Previous experience working on a B2B/SaaS product

title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
description:
At CesiumAstro , we are developers and pioneers of out-of-the-box communication systems for satellites, UAVs, launch vehicles, and other space and airborne platforms. We take pride in our dynamic and cross-functional work environment, which allows us to learn, develop, and engage across our organization. If you are looking for hands-on, interactive, and autonomous work, CesiumAstro is the place for you. We are actively seeking passionate, collaborative, energetic, and forward-thinking individuals to join our team. 

We are looking to add a Senior Mechanical Engineer to our Mechanical Engineering team. If you enjoy working in a startup environment and are passionate about developing space hardware for leading-edge communications satellites, we would like to hear from you. 

In this position, you will be responsible for mechanical design aspects of Cesium phased array antennas, subsystems, and interfaces through all phases of the development process. The ideal candidate will be versatile and proficient in mechanical analysis, electronics packaging, computer-aided design (CAD), mechanical interfaces, thermal architecture, spacecraft propulsion, deployable and actuated structures, and environmental qualification of spacecraft antennas and payloads. You will be responsible for mechanical designs from concept through space flight including requirements definition, architecture trades and block diagrams, analysis, manufacturing, testing, qualification, and in-orbit support. 

The successful candidate will also present engineering design review materials to our customers and executive team, as well as participate in proposal-writing efforts. As such, excellent written and verbal communication skills are required. 

JOB REQUIREMENTS AND MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS 

- Bachelor of Science (BS) in Mechanical or Aerospace Engineering from an accredited university or institution 

- Minimum of 5 years of experience in space antenna and payload mechanical engineering to include electronics packaging, thermal, shock, vibration, stress dynamics, and cost. A Master's degree may count as two years of experience. 

- Experience in conducting architectural trade studies including parametric and first-order cost and physical analysis 

- Experience with professional mechanical and FEA CAD tools, such as Ansys Mechanical, SolidWorks Simulation, and Thermal Desktop 

- Experience with CNC manufacturing and GD&T 

- Experience with advanced aerospace manufacturing and materials including sandwich panels and carbon composites, OR experience with high-reliability deployment mechanisms for space applications (including deployment, HDRMs, power delivery, etc.).

- Proficiency in detailed mechanical design (3D CAD, drawings, etc.) 

- Experience designing and manufacturing mechanisms and mechanical actuators 

- Experience with EMI/EMC mitigation techniques 

- Familiarity with satellite thermal architectures including heat pipes, phase change materials, contact resistance, and surface finishes as well as fundamental understandings of orbital thermal control in a LEO environment. 

- Familiarity with launch and LEO environments (thermal, shock, vibe, radiation, etc) 

- Familiarity with design for test, manufacturability, assembly, and reliability 

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills 

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE 

- Python, C++, or other programming languages 

- Experience with large, deployable antenna arrays which drive your vision for the next generation of on-orbit communications and sensor arrays.

- Robotics and control systems experience 

- PCBA experience.

CesiumAstro considers several factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to, the role and associated responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, education/training, and key skills.

Please be aware that many roles will be subject to both security and export control restrictions. title: Lead Marketing Data Analyst (x/f/m)
description:
Vos missions 

Nous recherchons un(e) Lead Marketing Data Analyst pour rejoindre l'équipe B2B Performance Marketing. En tant que Lead Marketing Data Analyst, vous êtes la référence analytique de l'équipe sur la performance d'acquisition, l'attribution et la valeur client. 

Vous transformez des données cross-canal complexes en concepts clairs et en recommandations concrètes qui influencent directement les décisions d'investissement, de ciblage et de croissance de l'équipe. Vous êtes le socle data sur lequel s'appuient le spécialiste CRM Tooling & AI et le Digital Analyst : vous garantissez que la bonne donnée est disponible, fiable et exploitable par tous.

Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les Data Product Managers pour trouver les bonnes solutions et aligner les équipes Data sur des définitions communes, des métriques partagées et une structuration cohérente de la donnée. Vous êtes également le partenaire des Sales Operations (équipe SCOPS) pour construire l'infrastructure de “lead scoring” qui connecte Marketing et Sales.

Vous évoluez dans un environnement AI-first : les modèles ML, les pipelines automatisés et l'analyse assistée par IA feront partie de votre quotidien.

Vos responsabilités incluent, mais ne sont pas limitées à : 

1. Attribution, parcours de conversion & incrémentalité (30%)

- Piloter le modèle d'attribution multi-touch de l'équipe entre SEO, acquisition payante et CRM

- Construire et maintenir une vue unifiée des parcours de conversion, exploitable depuis le data warehouse

- Définir et documenter les définitions de conversion communes sur lesquelles toute l'équipe s'aligne

- Accompagner les équipes Paid et CRM dans la mesure de leur impact (tests d'incrémentalité, Marketing Mix Modeling, Causal Impact…)

- Travailler avec les Data Product Managers pour s'assurer que les modèles de données et les flux associés sont correctement structurés et maintenus

2. LTV/SAC, analyses de cohortes & reporting à la Direction (25%)

- Suivre la LTV et le SAC par canal d'acquisition, segment et cohorte

- Construire et maintenir les courbes de rétention par cohorte (J7, J30, J90) et identifier les moments de churn

- Déterminer quelles sources d'acquisition et quels segments génèrent la plus forte valeur à long terme

- Développer des modèles de prévision en collaboration étroite avec les équipes Data et Finance

- Produire le reporting LTV/SAC mensuel qui guide les décisions d'allocation budgétaire et préparer les synthèses de performance partagées avec la Direction

3. Scoring des leads & partenariat avec les équipes commerciales (20%)

- Concevoir et déployer un modèle de scoring des leads basé sur le machine learning avec l'équipe SCOPS, pour déterminer quels leads sont transmis aux commerciaux et lesquels sont nurturés en CRM

- Traduire les données comportementales et d'engagement en un modèle de scoring activable dans le CRM, en coordination avec le spécialiste CRM Tooling & AI 

- Faire évoluer le modèle au fil des nouvelles données et des retours des équipes commerciales

4. Disponibilité de la donnée & support de l'équipe (15%)

- Être le partenaire data du spécialiste CRM Tooling & AI et du Digital Analyst : garantir que la donnée dont ils ont besoin est disponible, bien documentée et fiable

- Traduire leurs besoins en exigences structurées pour les Data Product Managers

- Identifier les problèmes de qualité de données en amont et les suivre jusqu'à leur résolution

- Être le lien entre l'équipe Performance Marketing et l'organisation Data

5. Tableaux de bord opérationnels & suivi de la performance (10%)

- Piloter les tableaux de bord de performance globale de l'équipe : acquisition, attribution, LTV/SAC et contribution par canal (suivi quotidien, pilotage hebdomadaire, vue mensuelle pour la direction)

- Mettre en place une détection automatique des anomalies, des synthèses narratives générées par IA et des analyses exploratoires assistées pour libérer du temps sur des travaux analytiques à plus forte valeur ajoutée

Les qualités attendues pour ce poste

Avant de poursuivre votre lecture, si vous n'avez pas le profil exact décrit ci-dessous, mais que vous pensez que cette description de poste correspond à vos compétences et à vos aspirations, nous vous encourageons tout de même à postuler.

Vous pourrez être le prochain membre de notre équipe si vous :

- Justifiez de 7 à 10 ans d'expérience en analytics marketing, growth analytics ou business analytics idéalement dans des scale-ups B2B SaaS

- Avez l'habitude de piloter un travail analytique de bout en bout, du modèle de données à la présentation à la Direction

- Maîtrisez les requêtes SQL de manière autonome au quotidien et avez travaillé directement avec BigQuery ou équivalent

- Avez une expérience concrète en attribution et/ou en incrémentalité : vous avez construit ou piloté un modèle d'attribution multi-touch, mené des tests d'incrémentalité (user-based, geolift) ou travaillé sur du Marketing Mix Modeling

- Avez une expérience en optimisation du funnel marketing :

- Stratégie d'acquisition & d'activation

- Modélisation de la LTV / SAC dans un contexte SaaS ou par abonnement : avoir réalisé des analyses LTV et SAC basées sur des cohortes, utilisées pour orienter l'allocation budgétaire ou des décisions stratégiques.

- Définition des KPIs et cadre de référence (MQLs, SQLs, Leads...)

- Expérience avec des outils de visualisation de données : Amplitude, Tableau, Looker, Metabase…

- Maîtrisez l'anglais et le français, à l'écrit comme à l'oral

Ce serait fantastique si vous aviez aussi :

- Des compétences en Python ou R pour la modélisation statistique avancée et le développement de modèles de machine learning

- Une connaissance des modèles de croissance tirés par le produit (product-led growth) et de la façon dont les données d'usage alimentent la mesure marketing

- Une expérience de management ou d'accompagnement d'analystes plus juniors

- Des notions d'allemand

- 10 jours par an de télétravail à l’étranger possible

- Adhésion au plan de partage de la valeur de Doctolib, appelé DoctoGrowth

- Pour les salariés en situation de handicap ou proches aidants, un package comprenant une adaptation du télétravail, des jours d'absence autorisée payés pour les rendez-vous médicaux et un soutien psychologique renforcé

- Aide au déménagement en cas de mobilité internationale

Le processus de recrutement

title: Founding Lead Engineer — AI & Workflow Automation
description:
Founding Lead Engineer — AI & Workflow Automation 

Founders Factory builds and funds startups together with exceptional entrepreneurs and leading companies. Founded by experienced entrepreneurs, we combine early-stage capital with a hands-on Venture Studio team across product, engineering, growth, talent and fundraising.

We’re now building a new venture tackling one of Germany’s biggest labour-market challenges: how to find, engage and hire skilled workers at scale. 

We’re looking for a hands-on Lead Engineer with founder ambitions to build the first product from scratch, with the opportunity to become the venture’s Technical Co-Founder.

The opportunity 

Recruiting skilled workers is still remarkably manual. Candidates are found across fragmented channels, contacted via WhatsApp or phone, qualified one by one, matched against roles and repeatedly chased for missing information.

We believe a large part of this workflow can be fundamentally redesigned using AI, conversational interfaces and automation .

You would build the first version: from candidate acquisition and qualification to matching, follow-up and integrations into existing recruiting workflows.

What we’re looking for 

- Strong full-stack engineer able to build independently from zero to working product

- Experience automating messy, real-world workflows

- Hands-on experience shipping LLM / AI-agent functionality to users

- Comfortable connecting APIs, databases, messaging tools and third-party systems

- Product-minded: you care about whether technology actually removes work and improves conversion

- High ownership and entrepreneurial ambition — whether as a founder, early engineer, freelancer or technical operator

- Familiarity with the DACH market; German strongly preferred

Particularly relevant 

Experience with recruitment or HR tech, ATS/CRM integrations, WhatsApp, voice AI, n8n/Make, matching systems, marketplaces or workflow-heavy SaaS would be highly relevant.

What we offer 

You’ll build the company from day one with capital and hands-on support from Founders Factory , working alongside an experienced venture team and with access to our network of founders, operators, corporate partners and investors.

This is an opportunity to build first, validate quickly and potentially step in as Technical Co-Founder of an independent venture-backed company.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Fundraising) — Remote
description:
About GiveDirectly 

What if the most effective way to fight poverty was also the simplest: give people money and trust them to decide what they need?

Since 2011, GiveDirectly has proven that idea at scale. We’ve delivered more than $1B in cash directly to 2+ million people living in poverty and crisis across 15 countries, and rigorous research shows the results: healthier kids, stronger businesses, sturdier homes, and more resilient families and local economies. Cash is now widely recognized as one of the most scalable, cost-effective, and dignified forms of aid.

Our ambition goes beyond our own programs. We want cash to become the benchmark for aid, much as the index fund became the benchmark for investing, so that every aid dollar is held to one question: is this doing more good than giving the money directly to people living in poverty? 

We’re growing fast, and this is a rare and important moment to join. 

We expect to hit $1B in revenue in 2026 with significant growth forecast for 2027. At the same time we are building a new technology stack and operating model designed for a roughly 10x change in scale, and we are actively pursuing partnerships with major funders to move even more money in bigger ways, to people who need it. We are known for our extensive integration of technology into field processes; our quantitative approach to performance measurement; and our commitment to rigorous, independent, experimental evaluation of our impact, with multiple Randomized Control Trials completed and others in progress.

How we work 

Our team spans 20+ countries and 69 languages. Our culture is candid, analytical, and non-hierarchical. We expect high ownership and give people real responsibility early. Our values are central to how we hire, work, and grow, and they are deliberately opinionated:

- Recipients first. Recipients’ preferences come before those of donors or ourselves.

- Team next. We optimize for organizational success, not individual success.

- Be proactively candid. We say what we believe and share information openly.

- Create positive energy. We aim to be a source of energy for colleagues, not a drain.

- Think rigorously; act quickly. We reason from first principles, then act rather than debate.

- Know yourself and grow. We own our imperfections and seek feedback to grow.

- Accept reality. Propose solutions. We focus on what can change and bring solutions, not just problems.

- Be productively ambitious. We take risks for step-change impact, not incremental progress.

If they describe how you like to work and they energize you, this could be a great fit.

Want to learn more? Read and listen: 

We are one of Time100’s Most Influential Companies of 2026, and our work has been covered by The Economist , NPR , TED , and The Washington Post . We're now preparing to deliver billions of dollars a year to people in extreme poverty, if funding allows. Read our CEO's essay on what that will take.

About this role: 

Are you an experienced engineer at the stage of your career where, above all, you want to do good? 

This role is about using engineering to support fundraising: delighting our donors; helping our fundraisers; getting donations recorded and safely started on their journey to our recipients; telling donors and the public about what happens to their gifts. A bit of website development. A lot of plumbing.

The good news about this position: 

- You will make a difference to people in extreme poverty

- You will work independently, with few constraints

- You will work directly with lovely people from across our fundraising teams

The trade-offs: 

- There is only one other fundraising engineer and mostly you will be working on your own

- Our technology is a mixture of boring (Laravel, PHP, plain JS, HTML and CSS) and legacy (Salesforce, Wordpress, wrangling CSV files sent by our partners)

- We're growing, but this is a role for someone who values depth and impact over a fast title ladder.

The maybe good maybe bad news about the role depending on who you are: 

- We are all in on AI where it allows us to get more $ to people in extreme poverty

If you want a role where you will be part of a bigger engineering team, working in Python or working on more complex tasks, then please take a look at our other engineering roles . 

This role is right for you if: 

- You care about our mission

- You agree with our values 

- You have the right to work in one of the countries we're able to hire from (you can check the current list here ).

- You're happy working remotely, and taking meetings across East Africa Time and US Eastern Time.

- You are happy to travel to meet your colleagues in the US, Europe and Africa a few weeks a year

- You are fluent in English

- You have 4+ years of engineering experience

- You're happy working autonomously: defining what needs doing, doing it, getting it tested and launched, fixing the bugs, and hustling to make progress every day.

- You're comfortable being on-call on peak donation days (Giving Tuesday and the last weeks of the year), including owning an incident: working out what matters, communicating with fundraisers, and debugging on legacy and others' code, sometimes when no other engineers are available.

- You are happy with our boring and legacy technologies (Laravel, PHP, plain JS, HTML, CSS, Salesforce, Wordpress, SQL, wrangling csv files etc). You don’t have to be experienced in all of them, but you do have to be genuinely happy to use them (many engineers are not…).

- You are happy and skilled at working directly with non-engineers on messy, poorly defined, rapidly changing, sometimes boring tasks

Compensation 

At GiveDirectly, we strive to pay our employees generously and equitably. We use an accredited third party salary aggregator to calculate what we believe to be competitive pay based on role, location, and cost of living. We also have a no negotiation policy to ensure we are paying staff equitably across roles. Read more about our compensation philosophy here .

Unless otherwise noted, the benefits stipend may be used to cover benefits or taken as additional taxable income.

United States 

- Base Salary: $181,130

- Bonus at Target Performance: 15% (~$27,170, with potential for upside. For reference, with the organization's current performance multiplier, this amount would be ~$31,789 in 2025)

- Estimated Total Compensation at Target: $208,300+

- Annual Benefits Stipend: $21,393

United Kingdom 

- Base Salary: £124,370

- Bonus at Target Performance: 15% (~£18,656, with potential for upside. For reference, with the organization's current performance multiplier, this amount would be ~£21,827 in 2025)

- Estimated Total Compensation at Target: £143,026+

- Annual Benefits Stipend: £2,760

Kenya 

- Base Salary: $112,350

- Bonus at Target Performance: 15% (~$16,853, with potential for upside. For reference, with the organization's current performance multiplier, this amount would be ~$19,717 in 2025)

- Estimated Total Compensation at Target: $129,203+

- Annual Benefits Stipend: $8,453

This role is fully remote, so if you are not based in the US, UK or Kenya, we will share an estimated salary benchmark for the country you are based in during the hiring process. 

Why work at GiveDirectly? 

At GiveDirectly, we work to ensure that you have everything you need to excel in your role and on your team, including:

- A positive and supportive team with opportunities for advancement 

- A demonstrated commitment to helping all staff develop and grow

- A competitive salary, including bonus

- A robust health benefits plan (exact details will vary by country)

- Unlimited PTO (that we encourage staff to take!)

- Desk allowance and flexible work location

About this specific hiring process 

- Take-home coding assignment

- Live Coding (60 mins)

- Systems Design (60 mins)

- Project Deep Dive + Behavioral (60 mins)

*It’s possible that there will be adjustments to this interview process. Any changes will be communicated to you during the process.

#LI-REMOTE

Working at GiveDirectly 

GiveDirectly is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to the person’s race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Flagging for US applicants: We invite you to " Know Your Rights " as an applicant.

Commitment to Safeguarding 

As a global organization working with communities to eliminate extreme poverty, GiveDirectly takes the safeguarding of its recipients, staff, and partners seriously. To that end, GiveDirectly is a member of the Misconduct Disclosure Scheme , and will systematically check with previous employers about any abuse or misconduct related matters involving potential new hires. We may also employ other robust pre-hire screens, including in-depth reference checks, criminal background checks, and sanctions screens.

These efforts help us continue to build and maintain trust with the communities we work with, and prevent abuse to our recipients and staff.

**GD is committed to observing all local, national and international laws that protect people and basic human rights of all. GD is committed to a policy of “zero tolerance when it comes to preventing, reporting, or responding to any form of abuse or exploitation.” and expects anyone who works for GD to uphold the protection and safeguarding of our recipients as a priority.**

Reasonable Accommodations 

We are committed to fostering an inclusive and accessible work environment. If you require any accommodations during the application or interview process, or to perform the essential functions of the role, please email us at careers@givedirectly.org with the email subject “Accommodation Needed”. We will work with you to ensure reasonable accommodations are made to support your needs.

Want to put your best foot forward on your GiveDirectly application? Take a look at our Candidate Application Prep Guide ! 

Referrals 

Know the right person for this role? Please consider referring them . We offer a reward of $3,000 for a Senior Manager or above role, and $500 for a Manager role, paid if we end up hiring your referral. Thank you for sending great people our way!

title: Alliances Field Engineer
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few roles based in offices. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are hiring an Alliances Field Engineer to help our biggest partners (companies like Intel, Nvidia, Google, Dell, HP, Accenture, Tata and the like) understand and embrace our open source platform for themselves and their customers.

Our worldwide field engineering team apply expert insights to real-world customer problems, enabling the enterprise adoption of Ubuntu, OpenStack, Kubernetes, AI/MLOps and a wide range of associated technologies. We are experts in the whole open source stack, from kernel to desktop, from cloud to the edge. Our team is also interested in business problems - building things reliably, efficiently and cost-effectively, and we have to learn to speak the language of our customers and their industries.

We help global companies embrace public and private cloud infrastructure, cloud native operations, and open source applications. For this team we are looking for several Alliances Engineers to support OEM (hardware manufacturers), GSI (global system integrators), ISV (independent software vendors), Channel partners and Public Cloud alliance partners. You will support various alliances and partners of Canonical to adopt our products and technologies, help business leaders to define joint go-to-market programs with partners from the technical standpoint.

We often say that our field engineers have 'the hardest job at Canonical' because customers can ask about any aspect of our solutions and products and expect a thoughtful, well-informed answer. We always want to do the best thing for our partners and customers, regardless of our company interests, and field engineers are the people we trust to ensure that is true.

Location : This is a home-based role, we are hiring worldwide.

What your day will look like

- Understand Ubuntu, Linux, networking and services in real-world environments

- Architect cloud infrastructure solutions like Kubernetes, Kubeflow, OpenStack, Ceph, and Spark either On-Premises or in Public Cloud (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud)

- Architect and integrate popular open source software such as PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Kafka, Cassandra and NGINX

- Help partners to offer and architect joint solutions utilizing Canonical’s technologies on top of the public clouds and in the data center

- Design and publish joint Reference Architectures and perform technical validations with various partners

- Prepare and run onboarding sessions/workshops with various partners’ teams to promote Canonical products and solutions

If you have a passion for the latest open source technologies, cloud-native development, data center technologies such as Kubernetes and computer networking, you will love the Alliances Engineer role at Canonical.

What we are looking for in you 

- Extensive experience with Linux (Ubuntu preferred), Kubernetes, Ceph, software automation

- Experience designing and implementing solutions on top of public or private clouds

- Python and bash understanding, troubleshooting skills

- Fluent written and spoken English

- Excellent communication and presentation skills

- High motivation, ability to multi-task and follow-up reliably on commitments

- Interest in customer-facing engagement, including pitching, demonstrating and understanding customer environment and needs

- Interest in new technologies like LXD, Juju and Snaps

- Ability to travel globally up to 30% of the time

- Degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics or related technical field experience

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

- Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we’ve been working remotely since 2004!

- Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year

- Annual compensation review

- Recognition rewards

- Annual holiday leave

- Maternity and paternity leave

- Employee Assistance Programme

- Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others

- Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.

Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004.​ Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

We believe policy is the control plane for network security: it defines what the environment should do, and the infrastructure carries it out. FireMon gives security teams one place to see, govern, and prove that their policy is doing what they intend, across on-prem, cloud, and hybrid environments.

As a Solutions Architect, you'll play a valuable role within the FireMon Customer Experience team, helping to assess business opportunities and support the development of strategies to address technical challenges. In this role, you'll work closely with security architects, infrastructure specialists, and engineering teams within customer organizations, gaining hands-on experience designing effective, results-driven solutions. You will support both Pre-Sale (Buyer's Journey) and Post-Sale (Customer Journey) phases, building your technical expertise and product knowledge along the way. With guidance from senior team members, you'll help empower customers to make informed decisions and achieve success in their projects.

Responsibilities 

- Contribute to the process improvement and implementation methodology focused on prescriptively and proactively getting a customer to value as quickly as possible.

- Provide thought leadership related to API integration as the right approach for the management and delivery of Automation and Workflow for our customers.

- Account for the decisions you propose and be an expert in the implementation of proposed solutions.

- Conduct business process analyses, needs assessments, and preliminary cost/benefits analyses to align technology solutions with business initiatives.

- Partner with users to define and analyze problems and align the most appropriate technical, application or configuration solutions.

- Help develop, document, and manage the requirements gathering process and provide detailed design and business processes to support the requirements throughout the project life cycle up to and through change control.

- Review system test plans and system test applications to ensure successful test cycles.

- Serve as a functional and technical resource for the project team and establish Level of Effort (LOE) and duration estimates for projects.

- Build architecture best practices.

Required Skills and Experience 

- Bachelor's degree in the field of Science, Technology, Engineering, Math, or equivalent practical experience.

- Five or more years of business analysis and consulting experience – to or within large corporations, relating to enterprise software implementation and change management.

- Five or more years of experience designing and implementing client-facing solutions.

- Strong problem solving and critical thinking skills

- Strong verbal and written communication skills

Preferred Skills and Experience

- Familiarity with multiple languages, including C++, Java, Python Perl, or another programming language

- Experience implementing solutions using API Management Platforms

- Experience in technology architecture and implementation on the ServiceNow platform

- Communicate solution recommendations and influence decision-makers

- Startup mentality with responsibilities for partner management

- Demonstrate experience across all phases of the SDLC and Agile software development practices

- 
Strong proficiency and hands-on expertise in Java, Scala, and Python.

- 
Practical experience building and operating event-driven applications or data pipelines in cloud environments (AWS).

- 
Direct experience operating containerized services on Kubernetes and delivering changes using Docker and GitOps workflows.

- 
Solid background in SQL, relational database design, data modeling, and distributed system fundamentals.

Nice-to-haves

- 
Experience working on high-throughput, low-latency streaming systems where data freshness is critical.

title: Staff Data Scientist, Pricing
description:
Help Us Build The Future of Travel 

At Airalo, we're making it easier for people to stay connected wherever they travel. As the world's first eSIM store, we help millions of travelers access affordable mobile data in 200+ countries and regions around the world.

Today, we're a team of 400+ people across 60+ countries, building a product used by travelers every day. We've grown quickly, but we've worked hard to keep what matters: trust, ownership, and the freedom for people to do great work without unnecessary layers or bureaucracy.

We're fully remote by design, genuinely global, and united by a shared mission to make travel simpler for everyone.

Your Next Destination 

- Location: Remote.

- Contract: Full-time, permanent.

- Benefits: Learn more about our benefits here in this link - https://airalo-public.notion.site/Benefits-25396a97ffca81fb9bc1f0be479f1be3?pvs=74 

- Languages: English is our main working language day to day, so you'll need to be comfortable communicating in it both in meetings and async.

We're looking for a Staff Data Scientist, Pricing to build the analytical and machine learning capability that pricing runs on, from demand modelling through to the systems that recommend price.

You won't be starting from zero. We've invested in the foundational data and infrastructure that pricing decisions depend on. What's missing is the capability on top: models the business trusts, experiments that settle pricing questions with evidence, and economics defined once so they hold consistently across Commercial, Product and the customer experience.

The arc of the role runs from measurement to prediction to prescription - understanding how demand responds to price, forecasting how it will respond, and ultimately building the models that recommend the price itself.

What You'll Do: 

- 
Build and own the demand and elasticity modelling capability, quantifying how price affects volume across destination, duration, data tier, and customer segment.

- 
Develop machine learning models for demand forecasting and willingness-to-pay, and take them from exploration through to production with the monitoring and retraining that keeps them honest.

- 
Move us from predictive to prescriptive by building the optimisation layer that turns forecasts and elasticities into recommended prices under margin, competitive and partner constraints.

- 
Design and analyse pricing experiments with statistical rigour, and apply causal methods where clean randomisation isn't possible.

- 
Define pricing within our data ecosystem, owning the governed definitions of price, cost and package economics that reporting, analysis and product surfaces all read from.

- 
Partner with Commercial and Finance to connect pricing decisions to margin and revenue, and to size opportunities before we commit.

- 
Set the analytical standard for pricing at Airalo, from what counts as evidence through to how a model or recommendation gets validated before it influences live pricing.

What You'll Bring: 

- 
7+ years in data science, quantitative economics, or applied research, including pricing, monetisation, or marketplace economics work that demonstrably changed decisions.

- 
Experience with dynamic or algorithmic pricing systems in production.

- 
An advanced degree in Econometrics, Statistics, Operations Research or similar, or equivalent applied depth in demand estimation and the identification problems that make naive price-quantity regressions wrong.

- 
Hands-on machine learning experience across the full lifecycle, from feature engineering and model selection through to deployment

- 
Familiarity with optimisation and decision-science methods that turn predictions into recommended actions, whether through constrained optimisation, bandits, or reinforcement learning approaches.

- 
Proven experimentation expertise, having designed and defended experiments with a clear view on decision frameworks and common failure modes.

- 
Experience building analytical capability where none existed before, turning raw data and a business question into something a commercial team uses repeatedly.

- 
Strong data modelling instincts, thinking in reusable definitions and single sources of truth rather than standalone analyses.

- 
The ability to move comfortably between financial, product and operational data and connect the analysis to a financial outcome.

- 
Genuine partnership instincts, translating between analytical rigour and commercial reality so that Commercial and Product come to you early rather than after the decision.

- 
Fluency in the Python ML stack alongside strong SQL, with the engineering hygiene to hand over code that others can run and maintain.

- 
Excellent communication skills, including the ability to make a methodological argument to people who won't check your standard errors.

- 
A self-starter mindset that thrives in ambiguity and brings structure without waiting for permission.

- 
Comfort using AI tools to augment analytical work, with a point of view on where they help and where they don't

Nice to have: 

- 
Experience in marketplace, telecom, travel, or subscription/usage-based businesses.

- 
Bayesian or hierarchical modelling for sparse segments and long-tail SKUs.

- 
Competitive price response modelling, or working with scraped competitor pricing data.

- 
Familiarity with dbt, LightDash, or similar semantic/BI layers.

- 
Experience designing semantic or metric layers consumed by both analytics and production systems.

- 
Experience working in cross-functional teams spanning commercial, finance and product disciplines.

If you are interested in this position, please apply via the link. 

Why People Join Us 

We started Airalo to make staying connected effortless, wherever you are in the world. Today, millions of travelers rely on our eSIMs, and many of the people building the product were customers first.

Our team spans 60+ countries, united by a shared belief that great work happens when people are trusted to own what they do. There's trust to own what you do, space to focus without constant layers of process, and a clear sense of what you're responsible for from day one.

As Airalo continues to grow, so do the opportunities to learn, take on new challenges, and make a real impact - from anywhere in the world.

title: Senior Data Scientist - Full Stack
description:

We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Data Scientist to join our Data & Analytics team at ClearScore. Data Scientists play a key role in our business, driving strategy and decision-making at all levels, which ultimately benefits our users, partners, and other teams across the organisation. We are seeking a proactive, outcomes-oriented individual, ready to take on broad ownership of a range of initiatives, to join our growing Global Targeting team. Working to enhance the ClearScore user experience through improved dynamic content targeting and prioritisation, you will take end-to-end ownership of data science and machine learning solutions across a variety of use cases, business areas, and markets. You’ll bring the knowledge and expertise required to evaluate transformative new approaches in machine learning and AI against our current implementations, applying your judgement and craft to incorporate these where they can add real value. Your contributions will directly support the Global Targeting mission, enabling the organisation to realise its overall strategy and goals.

ClearScore is both a free credit score and report service and the UK's leading consumer credit marketplace. ClearScore has an amazing analytical community which includes Data Analysts, Scientists and Engineers. The community works collaboratively, sharing knowledge, tools, and best practice, to ensure a landscape in which team members can develop their full potential and deliver maximum positive business impact.

What you’ll be doing 

- Leading the end-to-end development of data science and machine learning solutions - from business concept through to impact evaluation - to enable a better user experience through data-driven Targeting

- Working closely with cross-functional stakeholders to shape how Data Science and the broader Targeting initiative can effectively support business needs to drive maximum impact

- Keeping our modelling practice at the cutting-edge: building a deep understanding of new developments in ML and AI, like Foundation Models, testing these rigorously against our production systems, and leading our adoption of those that prove their value to drive better outcomes for our users and business

- Helping to set the quality bar for what we put into production: scrutinising data, features and model behaviour, and surfacing problems in our data and processes before they reach our users

- Identifying and implementing improvements and optimisations in our model development and management processes, driving more efficient and standardised ways of working, leading by example in what you deliver

- Driving the strategic utilisation of model outputs for decision making, working with the Global Targeting squad to use model outputs to change what users see

What you’ll need to succeed in the role 

- A self-starter mindset: curious, collaborative, and committed to continuous learning - including the adoption of new tools as they emerge. You stay abreast of advances in ML and AI, demonstrating the judgement required to assess when newer techniques will outperform conventional ones and when they won’t

- A desire to deeply understand a problem and its importance to the business before attempting to solve it, and being comfortable proactively seeking that context rather than waiting for it

- A strong ability to think critically about, and reason concisely with, data. A drive to understand our users, products, and how users interact with them, and to build an advanced knowledge of our data assets and how these connect to our users’ financial wellbeing through the product experience

- Advanced Python and SQL skills, and a strong understanding of dbt and Analytics Engineering for feature engineering. In-depth knowledge of varied statistical and machine learning techniques. You're capable across the full model lifecycle, including how models get deployed and maintained effectively in a production environment

- Demonstrable experience of using business-domain knowledge to drive model development or derive insights from data

- The ability to explain the key findings from complex analysis and modelling exercises to both technical and non-technical audiences. You feel at home interacting with stakeholders from across different specialisms around the organisation

We’d especially love to hear from you if you have 

- Experience using AI tools as part of your everyday workflow, with the judgement to know what to trust, what to verify, and when the output isn't good enough. We’re increasingly adopting AI tools as part of our development cycle, so an interest and knowledge of harnessing these effectively would be highly valued

- Hands-on experience developing and delivering solutions based on emerging ML/AI approaches in Deep Learning, such as representation learning, sequence models, transformer-based modelling, or foundation models

- Experience developing or working on real-time / near real-time inference solutions and the infrastructure to support them

- Experience working with and deploying solutions into Databricks

- Experience working in a product-focussed environment, partnering closely with cross-functional teams to build and iterate quickly

- A good understanding of consumer lending and the key drivers of credit and affordability strategies, as well as familiarity with credit bureau data and its effective utilisation for building predictive ML models

- A postgraduate degree or equivalent qualification in a STEM field

Why ClearScore? 

ClearScore is the UK's #1 credit score and report app. We are also present in South Africa, Australia and Canada, with more than 20 million users globally and growing fast. Someone joins ClearScore every 20 seconds. We have established relationships with over 50 of the main lenders in the U.K., and have been a trusted tool for customers to manage their credit and make better financial decisions.

Since October 2016 we have helped 1.8 million users take out a new credit card or loan. We are user-centric at our core and we believe in leveraging technology to enable positive financial choices. We are design-led and data-driven and we embed these behaviours in everything we do.

Our company culture is a fundamental part of all we have achieved. We believe in hiring smart, driven, passionate and diverse people who are keen on having a real impact in our organisation. We trust you to manage your own time so we offer flexible work and no fixed desk hours. We don't micromanage and we believe in measuring outcomes rather than effort. We have an inclusive culture where all, regardless of seniority, are encouraged to contribute with their ideas, look after their wellbeing and actively seek opportunities for career growth.

If you feel like this could be the place for you, apply and our Talent team will be happy to share more.

Benefits: 

- 25 paid holidays and a “duvet day” on your birthday

- Hybrid Work Environment

- Private health and dental cover - including mental health support through Bupa 

- GP office visits

- Life assurance scheme

- Up to 6% matched pension

- Regular Lunch and Learns with guest speakers

- Dog-friendly office

- Daily breakfast and free snacks

- Continued investment into learning and development 

- Leadership-led training

- In-house psychotherapist

- Financial coach to help you plan and achieve your goals

- No clock-watching culture

- Generous maternity and paternity plans

- Culture and inclusion representatives

- Transparent pay structure and a career growth plan

Equal Opportunities 

ClearScore is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified individuals. As an equal opportunity employer, we are able to make reasonable adjustments to accommodate individuals with disabilities during the recruitment and selection process. If you require accommodation, please inform us in advance, and we will work with you to meet your needs.

Our Hybrid Model 

We embrace a dynamic hybrid work environment that balances flexibility with collaborative in-person experiences. Our approach is designed to foster innovation, team connection, and individual productivity.

- Levels 1-5: Minimum 2-3 days per week in-office

- Level 6 and above: Minimum 3 days per week in-office

We believe this structure offers the best of both worlds - the flexibility of remote work and the synergy of face-to-face collaboration. Our office days are carefully coordinated to maximise team interactions and learning/ mentorship opportunities.

What This Means for You: 

- Flexibility to manage your work and life

- Dedicated in-office days for team building and collaborative projects

We’re committed to creating an inclusive environment that accommodates diverse needs while maintaining our collaborative culture. Join us in shaping the future of work!

Bonus Points

- Experience with detection-as-code: authoring, testing, and versioning detection content managed in Git

title: Fleet Management Data Analyst SIOP - Rotterdam
description:
International, centrally positioned role with direct impact on the deployment of thousands of tank containers worldwide. 

You have a good job. But you feel there’s more in it for you.

Maybe you’re looking for greater international impact. Or you’re ready to move beyond environments where data lags behind reality.

At our client, that’s exactly the challenge.

Today, the global fleet is still largely managed through manual spreadsheets . Data is fragmented, often outdated, and not available in real time.

You are going to fundamentally change that. 

For one of the world’s largest tank container leasing companies — managing over 75,000 tank containers globally — we are looking for a Data Analyst for an internationally focused, centrally positioned role based in Rotterdam.

In this role, you don’t just report on numbers — you directly influence the deployment, availability, and planning of tank containers worldwide . Your work ensures that stakeholders across the globe can generate accurate, real-time reports at any moment and use them for decision-making.

This level of tangible impact is rare in a data analyst role. 

About the organization 

Our client is one of the largest tank container leasing companies in the world. With a global fleet and international customer base, data plays an increasingly critical role in its success.

The organization is undergoing a transition from manual, Excel-driven processes to data-driven operations with real-time insights .

As part of the Marmon Group (a Berkshire Hathaway company) , you benefit from a strong international foundation combined with the dynamics of an evolving organization.

The culture is open, international, and results-driven, offering significant responsibility and room for initiative.

Tasks

Your challenge 

As a Data Analyst, you operate at the heart of an international operation. You ensure a single source of truth and support the Sales, Inventory & Operations Planning (SIOP) process.

You work with data from multiple systems — including ERP (legacy), CRM (Dynamics), WMS, and depot software — and translate this data into clear, actionable insights .

You identify deviations and convert them into concrete actions that directly impact operations.

You ensure stakeholders no longer rely on outdated figures, but instead work with real-time dashboards and reporting that drive international decision-making.

You report directly to the Global Fleet Manager and collaborate closely with stakeholders across Operations, Finance, and IT .

Although you work within an international team, your role is centrally positioned in Rotterdam , supporting global fleet management across Europe, the Americas, Asia, and China .

The first months are critical for success. 
You start by taking over existing processes and ensuring continuity in reporting. From there, you progressively improve, automate, and professionalize data and dashboards.

What will you do? 

- Consolidate, structure, and validate data from multiple sources

- Ensure reliable and consistent data across global operations

- Build and improve real-time dashboards and reporting in Power BI 

- Develop and monitor KPIs for the global fleet

- Analyze deviations and drive performance improvements

- Translate data into actionable insights and business decisions 

You make the difference by making data usable — not just visible .

Requirements

Your profile 

This role suits you if you look beyond numbers and want to make a real impact in an international supply chain environment.

- Bachelor’s degree (e.g. in Data, Supply Chain, or Business Administration)

- Minimum 5 years of experience as a Data Analyst within a logistics, manufacturing, or supply chain environment

- Strong skills in Excel, Power BI (including DAX), and SQL 

- Strong analytical mindset with the ability to identify patterns quickly

- Confident and effective in working with international stakeholders

- Proactive, with the ability to provide both solicited and unsolicited advice

International experience is essential. 
You have worked in a global supply chain environment (e.g. logistics, leasing, shipping, or manufacturing) and have proven experience with SIOP processes .

You are not a pure IT specialist, but a business-oriented data analyst who understands how processes work and how data drives decision-making.

Additionally:

- Fluent in English (Dutch is a plus)

- Available for a full-time role (40 hours) 

- Comfortable working across multiple time zones

Technical qualifications 

In this role, you operate at the intersection of data and supply chain. Therefore, experience with the following is important:

- Approximately 4–7 years of experience in data or business analytics within supply chain or SIOP

- SQL, data modeling (star/snowflake), Power BI (DAX), and Excel (Power Query / Power Pivot) 

- Data quality frameworks and master data management 

- Demand planning, inventory management, and SIOP processes 

- Connecting operational and financial data 

- Collaboration with Finance on reporting and forecasting

- Working with international stakeholders across multiple time zones

Preferred 
D365 F&O · Azure / Synapse / Databricks / Data Lake · SAP IBP, Kinaxis, or Anaplan · Python or R · Power Automate · external data sources (market data, POS, distribution data)

Benefits

What’s in it for you? 

A role with real impact, within an international organization that is evolving rapidly.

- Gross monthly salary up to €5,800 (based on full-time, depending on experience)

- One-year contract with the prospect of a permanent position

- 26 vacation days + 8% holiday allowance 

- Laptop and mobile phone

- Personal development budget (training, courses, tools)

- Collective pension scheme

You will have the opportunity to shape this role and make a direct contribution to the organization’s professionalization.

Apply 

Excited? Apply now.

Maurice den Hartog – MdH Recruitment 
+31 6 46700806
