title: Senior Data Analyst / Software Engineer
description:
Data, software & technische toepassingen 

FULLTIME · ROTTERDAM 

Wil jij data en software inzetten voor een fysieke technologie die bijdraagt aan een energiezuinigere en duurzamere glastuinbouw? 

Thermeleon ontwikkelt een innovatieve Warmtebatterij voor hightech kassen. Onze projecten leveren uiteenlopende klimaat-, energie-, sensor- en productdata op. Deze data vormt de basis voor betrouwbare analyses, klantinzichten en verdere verbetering van onze technologie. 

We zoeken een Senior Data Analyst / Software Engineer die sterke analytische vaardigheden combineert met praktische softwareontwikkeling. Je helpt een schaalbare data- en softwareomgeving op te bouwen: van data-inname en kwaliteitscontrole tot dashboards, analyseprocessen en technische tools. 

Je werkt niet op afstand van het fysieke product. Je werkt direct samen met engineers, onderzoekers en analisten aan toepassingen voor kas- en klantprojecten.

Taken

Wat ga je doen? 

Data-infrastructuur en datakwaliteit 

Je ontwerpt en ontwikkelt betrouwbare datastromen voor sensoren, technische systemen en andere relevante databronnen. 

Je structureert de opslag, verwerking en beschikbaarheid van project- en tijdreeksdata. 

Je ontwikkelt methoden om data uit verschillende systemen en formaten goed samen te brengen. 

Je automatiseert controles, monitoring en foutafhandeling. 

Je stelt praktische standaarden op voor datakwaliteit, documentatie, traceerbaarheid en versiebeheer. 

Je zorgt dat data bruikbaar en beschikbaar is voor analyses, dashboards, technische evaluaties en productontwikkeling. 

Je houdt rekening met passende toegang en bescherming van klantdata en interne kennis. 

Data-analyse en technische inzichten 

Je ontwikkelt herbruikbare analyseprocessen voor klimaat-, energie- en productdata. 

Je analyseert tijdreeksen en helpt verschillen tussen situaties, perioden en projecten te verklaren. 

Je ondersteunt de ontwikkeling van betrouwbare vergelijkingen, baselines en prestatieberekeningen. 

Je vertaalt statistische en technische resultaten naar duidelijke inzichten voor engineers en andere collega’s. 

Je beoordeelt en verbetert analyses van de Data Analyst. 

Je werkt samen met Performance en R&D om technische methoden om te zetten in betrouwbare analyses. 

Je bepaalt welke analyses geautomatiseerd kunnen worden en waar inhoudelijke interpretatie nodig blijft. 

Software en technische tools 

Je bouwt software waarmee technische teams projecten sneller en consistenter kunnen analyseren. 

Je ontwikkelt praktische tools voor berekeningen, scenarioanalyses, projectevaluaties en technische besluitvorming. 

Je zet prototypes en onderzoeksresultaten om in betrouwbare, onderhoudbare software. 

Je integreert relevante interne en externe rekenmethoden in bruikbare toepassingen. 

Je ontwikkelt waar relevant koppelingen met externe systemen en platforms. 

Je werkt mee aan zowel de technische achterkant als gebruiksvriendelijke interfaces. 

Je zorgt dat technische kennis op een veilige en beheersbare manier in software wordt toegepast. 

Dashboards en rapportages 

Je ontwikkelt interne en klantgerichte dashboards voor het monitoren en evalueren van projecten. 

Je bouwt duidelijke visualisaties van klimaatomstandigheden, energiegebruik en productprestaties. 

Je automatiseert terugkerende rapportages met behoud van traceerbare berekeningen en aannames. 

Je zorgt dat dashboards en rapportages begrijpelijk zijn voor engineers, telers en commerciële collega’s. 

Je ontwikkelt herbruikbare rapportages voor verschillende typen projecten en klanten. 

Je bewaakt dat klantgerichte resultaten aansluiten op de onderliggende gevalideerde methoden. 

Technisch eigenaarschap en begeleiding 

Je maakt technische keuzes die passen bij een groeiende organisatie en toekomstige opschaling. 

Je introduceert praktische standaarden voor softwareontwikkeling, documentatie, testen en versiebeheer. 

Je begeleidt de Data Analyst of werkstudent en beoordeelt complexere analyses en ontwikkelwerkzaamheden. 

Je helpt software- en datawerk te prioriteren op basis van behoeften vanuit klantprojecten, engineering en productontwikkeling. 

Je bepaalt wanneer een snelle analyse voldoende is en wanneer een schaalbare softwareoplossing nodig is. 

Je werkt waar nodig samen met externe specialisten. 

Je helpt de bredere Data & Software-functie binnen Thermeleon op te bouwen. 

Hoe werk je samen met de andere functies? 

Je werkt nauw samen met de Lead Application & Systems Engineer en de Data Analyst. 

De Lead Application & Systems Engineer bepaalt welke klant- en engineeringvragen moeten worden beantwoord. 

Jij vertaalt die vragen naar passende data-, analyse- en softwareoplossingen. 

De Data Analyst ondersteunt bij datavoorbereiding, analyses, dashboarding, monitoring en rapportages. 

Performance en R&D ontwikkelen en valideren technische methoden en onderliggende kennis. 

Jij vertaalt deze methoden naar betrouwbare analyseprocessen en bruikbare software. 

Productontwikkeling en Hardware leveren technische vereisten en productinformatie. 

Samen zorgen jullie dat projectdata wordt omgezet in inzichten, klantwaarde en productverbeteringen. 

Jij bent verantwoordelijk voor de kwaliteit, betrouwbaarheid en schaalbaarheid van de data- en software-implementatie. Performance en R&D blijven verantwoordelijk voor de inhoudelijke validatie van technische methoden. De Lead Application & Systems Engineer blijft verantwoordelijk voor de toepassing in het geïntegreerde klantadvies.

Vereisten

Wie zoeken we? 

Je hebt een relevante hbo- of wo-opleiding, bijvoorbeeld in computer science, data science, engineering, toegepaste wiskunde, natuurkunde of een vergelijkbaar vakgebied. 

Je hebt meerdere jaren relevante ervaring in data engineering, analytics engineering, software engineering of technische data-analyse. 

Je hebt sterke Python-vaardigheden en ervaring met het bouwen van onderhoudbare software- of analysetoepassingen. 

Je hebt ervaring met tijdreeksdata, API’s, databases en dataverwerking. 

Je hebt ervaring met back-endontwikkeling en met het opleveren van praktische interfaces of dashboards. 

Je bent analytisch sterk en kunt je verdiepen in fysieke en operationele systemen. 

Je kunt verkennende analyses en prototypes omzetten in robuuste, herbruikbare oplossingen. 

Je kunt pragmatische technische keuzes maken binnen een groeiende organisatie. 

Je beheerst het Engels professioneel. Nederlands is waardevol, maar geen vereiste. 

Je kunt technische keuzes duidelijk uitleggen aan collega’s zonder softwareachtergrond. 

Extra waardevol 

Ervaring met data uit energie, industrie, gebouwtechnologie, glastuinbouw of IoT. 

Kennis van statistiek, experimenteel ontwerp en onzekerheidsanalyse. 

Ervaring met cloudinfrastructuur, geautomatiseerd testen en deployment. 

Ervaring met Python, SQL en relevante data- en visualisatietools. 

Ervaring met tijdreeks- en sensordata. 

Ervaring met het omzetten van technische of wetenschappelijke rekenmethoden naar softwaretoepassingen. 

Ervaring met het begeleiden van junior analisten of ontwikkelaars. 

Interesse in thermodynamica, energiesystemen of glastuinbouw. 

Je past waarschijnlijk goed bij ons als je 

Graag werkt op het snijvlak van data-analyse en softwareontwikkeling. 

Wilt dat je werk invloed heeft op een fysiek product en echte klantprojecten. 

Structuur kunt aanbrengen in data en systemen die nog in ontwikkeling zijn. 

Zowel analytische correctheid als bruikbaarheid en onderhoudbaarheid belangrijk vindt. 

Minder ervaren collega’s graag helpt zich te ontwikkelen. 

Praktische tools wilt bouwen die daadwerkelijk binnen projecten worden gebruikt.

Benefits

Wat bieden we? 

Een sleutelrol in de ontwikkeling van onze data- en softwareomgeving. 

Een brede functie waarin data engineering, analyse, software en productontwikkeling samenkomen. 

Directe betrokkenheid bij fysieke systemen en praktijkprojecten. 

De mogelijkheid om technische keuzes, standaarden en werkwijzen mede te bepalen. 

Samenwerking met engineers, onderzoekers, telers en technologiepartners. 

De mogelijkheid om collega’s te begeleiden en de Data & Software-functie verder op te bouwen. 

Een passend salaris en arbeidsvoorwaardenpakket op basis van je ervaring. 

Een hybride werkomgeving rond ons kantoor in Rotterdam.

Over Thermeleon 

Thermeleon ontwikkelt een innovatieve Warmtebatterij voor de glastuinbouw. Met onze technologie helpen we telers hun fossiele warmtevraag, energiekosten en CO₂-uitstoot te verlagen. 

We werken samen met telers, kennisinstellingen en technologiepartners om onze technologie verder te ontwikkelen, te valideren en toe te passen. Binnen Thermeleon werk je direct aan de verbinding tussen fysieke technologie, software, data en de praktijk in de kas.

title: Senior Product Manager II, Consumer (all genders)
description:
The role 

HelloFresh serves millions of customers weekly across 18 business units and 8 brands worldwide. At the heart of our product is a belief that every customer deserves a menu that feels like it was made for them, the right meals, at the right time, for the right person. We call it the Sous Chef vision.

As Senior PM II on the Personalization Experience team , you own what makes that vision real and felt . You're not building the ranking algorithm, you're building the experiences that make customers trust it, the data collection that makes it smart, and the moments where someone thinks: this app actually knows me .

This is a high-autonomy role at the intersection of consumer UX, engineering, and ML systems. The problems are genuinely hard, the scale is real, and the decisions are yours to make.

What you’ll do 

- Food Profile Quality & Signal Collection: The food profile is the raw material that powers everything downstream. Your job is to move customers from "fields filled in" to truly Personalization-Ready: high-signal, validated, actionable. You'll own and iterate on the collection experiences that give our models the data they need to perform.

- The "Sous Chef" Feel & Transparency: You build the moments where personalization becomes tangible, the places where we tell customers why certain meals were chosen for them. This isn't just UX work, it's trust infrastructure for the entire personalization stack.

- Cross-Org Data Supplier : You're the clean, reliable interface between raw signal and downstream experience, owning the explanation payloads and API contracts that make it all work at scale. You operate across organizational boundaries and align on shared metrics without needing to own the surfaces.

- AI-Native Discovery You use GenAI tools actively to compress discovery-to-decision cycles, synthesizing global customer signals, stress-testing hypotheses, and arriving at decision-ready specs faster than traditional PM workflows allow. You don't treat AI as a novelty; it's a genuine speed and quality multiplier in your daily practice.

- Long-Horizon Strategy You manage your domain with real autonomy. You run a flywheel: better profile data → better models → more visible personalization → more signal back to personalization. You own the strategy and sequencing, not just the backlog, thinking 12–18 months out and making the calls that shape the direction of the team.

What you’ll bring 

- Deep personalization or data-collection PM experience. 5+ years of PM experience, with meaningful time on user-facing personalization or data collection products, ideally where the UX is the data pipeline, and where you've shipped for both end customers and downstream data consumers.

- Strong product taste and customer-facing craft. You have a genuine feel for what makes a consumer experience compelling, trustworthy, and sticky, not just functional. You've built products at scale where millions of people interact with what you ship, and you hold a high bar for the details: the copy, the interaction pattern, the moment of delight. You know the difference between a feature that works and one that earns trust.

- Data-native. You query your own data (SQL/Python), define your own input/output KPIs, and hold your own in deep-dive technical discussions without needing a data analyst to translate.

- Cross-org credibility. You've shipped products across organizational boundaries, aligning on shared metrics, maintaining clean contracts with engineering partners, and navigating competing priorities without direct authority.

- Experimentation with healthy skepticism. You design experiments to validate hypotheses and know how to interpret results without over-indexing on noise. You've made hard calls to kill features based on data.

- Exceptional communicator. You can make a complex algorithmic concept legible to a non-technical VP and you can write a spec that engineers can actually ship from.

- The AI edge. You've already incorporated AI-assisted workflows into your daily practice to increase speed, depth of insight, and output quality.

What we offer 

Elevate your lifestyle! Join one of Europe's fastest-growing tech powerhouses in a dynamic phase of expansion.

- Immerse yourself in a diverse global community of 90+ nationalities.

- Enjoy a competitive compensation package that goes beyond the norm, with perks like a HelloFresh- subsidized Pension Scheme, Berlin relocation support, and a Hybrid working model.

- Elevate your lifestyle with exclusive discounts on your weekly HelloFresh box and office meals.

- Invest in your growth with a German language learning budget, and access to the HelloFresh Academy.

- Plus, we've got your well-being covered with mental health support, transportation perks, and working-parent-friendly benefits. From our 24/7 gym access,wellbeing platforms like Headspace and Spill, to sabbatical leave options, HelloFresh is not just a workplace; it's a lifestyle of perks and possibilities!

title: Deployment Strategist
description:
Headquarters: Remote - India

About the Team 

The FDE (Forward Deployed Engineering) team is a new, strategic initiative sponsored from the CEO and Founders down. Our mission is to win C-suite-sponsored, high-value AI opportunities by selling and delivering outcomes , not just a platform.

You will be part of the founding team, embedded with our most strategic customers from the very first sales call, all the way through to a production-ready solution. You will be the "product manager" for the customer's problem, responsible for the "why" and "what," while our FDEs (Engineers) will be your partners responsible for the "how."

Role Description 

As a Deployment Strategist (DS), you are the critical bridge between a customer's multi-million-dollar business problem and Databricks' technical solution. You are a product manager for the field, owning the technical and product direction of the engagement from initial discovery through production launch and adoption.

You will build C-suite trust, perform deep discovery to map the customer's political and technical landscape, and scope the value. You will define the Minimum Viable Product for a pilot, write the PRD that guides the engineering team, and manage the project to a successful landing. You will also lead technical discovery, shape solution architecture with FDEs, and ensure that each proposed solution can move from prototype to production.

This role requires a rare combination of executive presence, deep product thinking, technical depth, and a hands-on delivery mindset.

The impact you will have

title: Senior AI Engineer
description:
About Mirakl: 

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl’s operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy’s, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information: www.mirakl.com .

Mirakl in Numbers: 

- 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40

- 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo

- 🇫🇷 350+ Mirakl Tech teams members mainly based in France

- ⚙️ 5 Saas Solutions

Our Values: 

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

- 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success

- 🏆 Get Things Done: We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results

- 🚀 Go Above & Beyond: We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence

- 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture

- 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

About the job 

Design, build, and scale production-grade AI systems that power the next generation of intelligent commerce.

You will work at the intersection of Software Engineering, Machine Learning, and Generative AI to build AI-native products, agentic systems, and platform capabilities used by Mirakl customers and internal teams.

This is a permanent position (CDI) based in Paris or Bordeaux, with 4 days on-site per week.

Annual gross salary range (package): €65,000 – €80,000 

This range is provided for transparency purposes and reflects our internal compensation grid for this role level. The final offer will be determined based on your experience, skills, and the scope of responsibilities involved.

Why Now, Why Mirakl 

Generative AI and AI Agents are fundamentally reshaping commerce software and the way our teams work on a day to day basis.

At Mirakl, AI is becoming a core part of our product strategy. From Catalog Transformer and content generation to AI Agents and Agentic Commerce, we are building the next generation of commerce software. And we have the same ambition for our teams around AI products and adoption.

We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to transform the way our internal teams work, and to have a significant impact on the agentic side of our Saas products.

You won't be joining a company that's thinking about AI. You'll be joining one that's already building it.

What You’ll Do 

1. Design & Build AI Systems 

- Design, build, and deploy production-grade AI systems for both Mirakl internal operations.

- Develop solutions leveraging: LLMs, RAG, AI Agents, Multimodal AI and Evaluation frameworks.

- Architect complex agentic workflows including tools, memory, retrieval, planning, and guardrails.

- Rapidly prototype new capabilities and evolve them into scalable, reliable AI production systems.

2. Integrate Across the Stack 

- Connect AI systems to internal platforms, business applications, and data sources across the company.

- Enable AI agents to interact with systems such as CRM, data platform, Drive, Jira, support tools, and internal knowledge bases.

- Design robust orchestration layers between models, APIs, tools, retrieval systems, and business workflows.

- Ensure reliability, observability, scalability, and maintainability across the entire AI stack.

3. Iterate for Impact 

- Partner with end users, business teams, Product Managers, and Engineers to identify high-value opportunities for AI.

- Run pilots and experiments, gather qualitative and quantitative feedback, and measure business impact.

- Analyze usage patterns, failure modes, costs, latency, and performance metrics.

- Continuously improve accuracy, reliability, adoption, and user experience through data-driven iteration.

4. Ensure Quality, Security & Reliability 

- Implement evaluation frameworks, guardrails, validation layers, and monitoring systems.

- Design AI systems that are secure, explainable, and production-ready.

- Ensure compliance with data security, governance, and access control requirements.

- Document architectures, capabilities, limitations, KPIs, and operational best practices.

5. Drive Adoption & Enablement 

- Build a scalable ecosystem of AI systems and agents that empower both internal teams and customers.

- Support teams in adopting AI-powered workflows and integrating AI into their daily operations.

- Contribute to AI engineering standards, reusable frameworks, and best practices across the company.

- Act as a champion for AI-driven ways of working and help shape Mirakl's transition toward Agentic Commerce.

Our stack and tools 

- 
Languages: Python and SQL

- 
AI Stack: OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Mistral and Open-source models

- 
Agentic & Retrieval: LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, MCP and Vector Databases

- Infrastructure: AWS or GCP, Docker and Kubernetes

What Makes You Successful 

- Strong engineering mindset: able to design reliable and scalable systems

- Strong AI expertise: able to translate the latest AI capabilities into production products

- Strong product mindset: able to balance technical excellence with business impact

- Focus on measurable outcomes, not technical complexity

Success Metrics 

- Product adoption and business impact

- Performance and reliability of AI systems

- Quality of AI outputs and evaluation metrics

You'll Love This Job If you have 

- 5+ years of experience in Software Engineering, ML Engineering, Applied AI, or related fields

- Strong Python and software engineering fundamentals

- Hands-on experience building production AI systems using LLMs, RAG, and AI Agents

- Experience designing multi-step agentic workflows and retrieval systems

- Experience evaluating AI systems and improving model performance

- Experience deploying and operating production services in cloud environments

- Strong communication skills in English

- Curiosity, pragmatism, and passion for building AI products

Feel free to add a link to your GitHub in your CV so we can understand what you have worked on!

Want to join us? Here is our process 

- A 30-40 min phone conversation with one of our Tech recruiters. This will be an opportunity to discuss your background, expectations, and discover what Mirakl can offer you in return.

- An initial 1h30 technical discussion with a member of the Data Science team and Engineering Team, which will allow you to delve into the more specific aspects of your expertise and discover how your skills can be integrated into our projects.

- 2 x 45-minute "STAR" interviews with future Mirakl colleagues to discuss our values and company culture.

We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. If you’re ready to join a global leader powering digital transformation for 450+ of the world’s most innovative retailers and B2B organizations. 

As part of our recruitment process, Mirakl processes your personal data to review and manage your application and, where appropriate, to consider your profile for future opportunities. You can exercise your data protection rights at any time, and as further detailed in our policies. For more information about how we process your personal data and your rights, please consult our Recruitment Privacy Notice, here in English and here in French.

While AI helps us work efficiently, all final hiring decisions are made by humans. For more information, visit our AI Guidelines for Candidates and Interviews .

We are hiring an Engineering Director , who strives for taking ownership of the development and operations of internal business systems integrations, a full data mesh solution built on top of leading open-source software, and the configuration of Salesforce, NetSuite, and other internal business systems. A successful candidate has a track record of leading the configuration, development and integrations of business systems, such as Salesforce or NetSuite, and data engineering/governance solutions. Such a candidate adheres to high engineering quality standards, and continuously develops their skills as well as skills of their direct reports. This is an exciting opportunity to work with highly enthusiastic people on exciting innovative engineering solutions supporting Canonical's growth and learn a lot about engineering for the business.

The engineering director will lead the Business Data unit that is conceived as three engineering teams that closely collaborate with other engineering and business teams at Canonical. Services designed, developed, and operated by the Commercial Systems unit are at the heart of Canonical business and data analytics and reporting. We are looking for a software engineering director to oversee the three software teams led by software engineering managers.

The Business Systems team is responsible for systems such as NetSuite, Salesforce, and several others. The engineers work closely with operations teams, implement business processes, and keep the systems compliant, while delivering first class experience to Canonical employees using those systems to get their job done.

The Data Lake team is responsible for building a comprehensive data mesh solution with a secure and well-governed access to data sets originating at many internal and external data sources . The team works with well-known open-source tools such as Trino, Ranger, and Superset, and develops tooling facilitating data governance processes.

The Integrations team is responsible for the integrations between internal and external systems used at Canonical and onboarding of new data sources to the data mesh. The team designs, develops, and operates Python workflows leveraging an open-source workflow orchestration engine Temporal. The team also integrates internal and external data sources into the data mesh using open-source ETL solution Airbyte, enabling more data driven decisions in the organization.

Location : This role will be based remotely in the EMEA region.

The role entails 

- Leading multiple teams of engineers, ranging from graduates to seniors

- Developing your engineering managers to maintain Canonical culture in their teams

- Developing and evangelize great engineering practices and processes in the teams

- Setting and implementing solid performance management with performance goals and objectives with your direct reports and teams

- Identifying and measuring indicators of team health, and take action where needed

- Being accountable for the product development roadmaps in the teams

- Being an active part of the Commercial Systems leadership team, collaborating with other leaders

- Expanding your teams by hiring great talent

- Collaborating with stakeholders and product users

What we are looking for in you 

- Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university

- Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path

- Proven ability to drive multiple teams or large teams of software engineers to deliver outstanding results

- Engineering experience in at least one of the following areas: CRM/ERP systems, Python, data engineering/governance, or distributed integrations

- Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results

- Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills

- Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments

- Ability to travel internationally twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long

Nice-to-have skills 

- Performance engineering and DevOps/SRE experience

- Experience with compliance

What we offer colleagues 

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. - Annual compensation review

- Recognition rewards

- Annual holiday leave

- Maternity and paternity leave

- Employee Assistance Program

- Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. title: Confirmed Machine Learning Engineer (Productivity)
description:
Notre mission ⚖️ 

Chez Doctrine, nous construisons le leader de l’IA juridique en Europe.

Notre conviction ? Le droit ne doit pas être ralenti par des tâches répétitives. Il doit être augmenté par une IA spécialisée, conçue pour comprendre, analyser et produire du raisonnement juridique avec un haut niveau d’exigence.

Notre ambition ? Permettre aux professionnels du droit de gagner en fiabilité, en efficacité et en sérénité, grâce à une plateforme unique, exhaustive et sécurisée.

Aujourd’hui, 27 000 professionnels du droit, répartis dans cinq pays (France, Italie, Allemagne, Espagne, Luxembourg), nous font confiance.

Notre développement est guidé par une approche claire : une vision globale, ancrée dans une compréhension fine des spécificités locales.

Derrière cette ambition, une équipe d’environ 250 personnes, réunies autour d’un même objectif : accompagner les juristes et avocats à toutes les étapes de leur travail, de l’analyse à la rédaction.

Et nous n’en sommes qu’au début.

Le contexte 

La squad Productivity est au cœur de la transformation produit autour de la gestion des affaires contentieuses de bout en bout.

Le scope de la squad s'est considérablement enrichi, au-delà du seul gain de productivité, en allant vers l'accompagnement de la réflexion et de l'argumentation juridique, à travers plusieurs langues.

Aujourd’hui, elle est responsable de toute la chaîne de valeur :

1. Analyse de documents

2. Rédaction automatisée des conclusions et documents juridiques

3. Réflexion stratégique sur l’argumentation

C’est le cœur de notre IA appliquée au raisonnement juridique : travail avancé sur les modèles LLM, le machine learning et la structuration de documents complexes.1.

Tu peux trouver des détails sur l’ensemble de la stack sur Github !

A savoir : il n’est pas nécessaire d’avoir une expérience professionnelle dans le domaine du droit, cependant l’envie de s’investir et de monter en compétence dans la compréhension des documents juridique est importante :)

Les missions 🛠 

- Développer des modèles NLP (basé sur le Machine Learning ou non) pour aider aider nos clients à être plus productif. Cela peut inclure l’aide à la recherche documentaire, l’aide à la génération de documents etc…

- Maintenir et monitorer ces modèles en production

- Collaborer avec différents types de profils, notamment ingénieurs, product managers, product designers, pour identifier de nouveaux axes de développement produit

- Participer à la diffusion interne et à la consolidation de nos bonnes pratiques dans le chapter ML; contribuer à l’élaboration de notre stratégie Engineering

- Faire monter en compétence les autres ingénieurs de l’équipe

Le profil idéal 👀 

- Une expérience significative en terme de construction de produit reposée sur le NLP, tel quel la reconnaissance d’entités nommées, la classification de texte, le résumé de texte, la modélisation de topic, la génération de contenu etc…

- Une bonne connaissance du machine learning et en particuliers des modèles de deep learning

- Une capacité à délivrer rapidement des prototypes dans un environnement product-centric

- Un fort intérêt pour les sujets d’intelligence artificielle

- L’envie d’identifier, d'analyser, et d'intégrer en production les dernières avancées scientifiques dans le domaine

- Une bonne maitrise du développement Python, avec un focus sur la construction d’algorithmes

- La maîtrise de la langue française et anglaise

title: Automotive MCU Chip Architect
description:
We are looking for an experienced Automotive MCU Chip Architect to define the system and subsystem architecture of next-generation automotive microcontrollers. The role includes ownership of chip-level architecture concepts, subsystem partitioning, compute and memory architecture, interconnect strategy, safety and security integration, power/reset/clock concepts, and hardware/software interface definition. The successful candidate will work closely with product management, safety, security, design, verification, software, and implementation teams to ensure the MCU architecture meets demanding automotive
requirements for real-time performance, functional safety, cybersecurity, reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency.

What you'll do 
Key Responsibilities

System Architecture Definition

- Define the overall automotive MCU architecture from product, customer, and market requirements.

- Translate use cases into chip-level requirements covering performance, safety, security, power, cost, and
scalability.

- Drive system partitioning across CPUs, memories, interconnects, peripherals, safety/security functions,
debug, test, and power domains.

- Own architecture trade-offs and document decision rationale for reuse across MCU families and
derivatives.

Subsystem Architecture Ownership

- Align subsystem concepts and interfaces across compute, memory, bus/interconnect, peripheral, safety,
security, power/reset/clock, debug/trace, and DFT/test domains.

- Ensure subsystem requirements are implementation-feasible and verifiable at RTL, subsystem, chip,
silicon, and software levels.

- Define hardware/software-visible architecture elements such as memory maps, register model
principles, interrupts, DMA, boot flow, and access-control concepts.

Cross-Functional Technical Leadership

- Lead architecture reviews and resolve trade-offs between product management, system engineering,
safety, security, design, verification, software, backend, test, and validation teams.

- Provide technical guidance during concept, design, verification, silicon bring-up, qualification, and
customer support phases.

- Ensure architectural consistency, requirement traceability, and risk closure across global engineering
teams.

What we require 
Required Technical Expertise

MCU / SoC Architecture

- Deep understanding of real-time MCU architectures, CPU subsystems, memories, peripheral integration,
low-power design, product-family scalability, and silicon implementation constraints.

Automotive Functional Safety

- Practical ISO 26262 expertise including ASIL concepts, safety goals, technical safety requirements,
FMEDA/DFA/FTA awareness, and definition of safety mechanisms at system and subsystem level.

Automotive Cybersecurity

- Understanding of secure boot, hardware root of trust, HSM integration, cryptographic accelerators, key
management, lifecycle states, secure debug, and ISO/SAE 21434 concepts.

Digital Design and Implementation Awareness

- Ability to reason about RTL feasibility, timing, area, power, DFT, backend constraints, IP integration,
verification closure, and bring-up observability.

Embedded Software Awareness

- Working knowledge of startup software, boot flows, drivers, AUTOSAR concepts, RTOS use, interrupts,
memory protection, debug, and software-visible register behavior.

Required Experience

- 10+ years in semiconductor, MCU, SoC, or embedded systems development.

- Several years in system architecture, subsystem architecture, or senior technical leadership.

- Hands-on experience with automotive MCU or automotive SoC products.

- Experience across concept definition, architecture specification, design support, verification support,
silicon bring-up, qualification, and customer support.

- Proven ability to work with international and cross-functional engineering teams.

title: Associate Data Scientist
description:
Description

Machine Learning Maestro: You donât just work with data - you decode it, predict the future with it, and turn it into action. Your models donât just sit on a shelf - they shape strategy, optimize efficiency, and fuel company growth. You thrive on uncovering hidden patterns, validating hypotheses, and embedding machine learning models into real-world AI applications. If that sounds like you - read on.

AlgaeCal is looking for a top-tier Associate Data Scientist who can turn raw information into strategies that drive measurable results.

This job will give you ALL the feels:

At AlgaeCal, weâre driven by a single idea. To end the fear of bone loss. In the United States, an estimated 54 million people have low bone density.

The good news? AlgaeCal has the worldâs only clinically-backed natural solution to this problem. We give hope to everyone worried about bone loss. If that excites you, youâll find no better place to continue your career than at AlgaeCal.

This job might be for you if youâve gotâ¦

- Experience as a Data Scientist (or a similar role) and can back it up with a resume that shows real results. Youâve built predictive models, optimized AI applications, and refined data architectures that have had a measurable impact. You donât just analyze numbersâyou translate data into actionable insights that drive business decisions.
- Serious coding skills in Python or R. You know how to build and refine machine learning models that actually work. Youâve used statistical modeling and data science tools to solve complex problems and unlock growth opportunities.
- Expertise in SQL and relational databases. Writing efficient queries? Optimizing data structures? Your resume is packed with quantifiable examples thatâll make us drool with desire! You know how to work with large datasets, ensuring data is organized, accessible, and primed for analysis.
- A deep understanding of machine learning algorithms. Whether itâs regression, clustering, or neural networks, you know how to choose the right approach for the right challenge. You donât just apply modelsâyou understand how they work under the hood.
- Hands-on experience with data warehouses. BigQuery or similar? Check. You understand how to design, maintain, and optimize scalable data storage solutions that support robust analytics.
- A knack for standardizing and improving data models. Youâve worked with data at scale, refining schemas and improving architectures to ensure efficiency, accuracy, and usability across the organization.
- A laser-sharp eye for detail. Youâre the kind of person who spots trends, outliers, and opportunities that others miss. Your ability to catch anomalies helps ensure our models and analytics are always on point.
- An entrepreneurial approach to data. You donât just crunch numbersâyou think strategically about how data can be leveraged to create business value. Youâre proactive in identifying new ways AI and machine learning can drive efficiency, sales, and profitability.
- Industry know-how that adds value. If youâve got experience in consumer packaged goods, e-commerce, or the health/supplement industry, thatâs a huge plus. You understand how data can shape customer experience, optimize operations, and maximize ROI.
Now, time to be honest: is this really you? If youâre nodding your head and feeling that flutter of excitement, then we canât wait to meet you.

Other Qualities Youâll Need

At AlgaeCal weâre going to insist that you have these 3 qualities:

- Youâre humbleââyou put the team and othersâ needs ahead of your own
- Youâre hungry to learn more
- Youâre people smartââin the sense that youâre a great teammate
The truth is, if you donât have these qualities you wonât last long at AlgaeCal. So if youâre missing one of them, be honest. Save yourself a lot of headaches and skip to a job posting that is a better fit for you.

What Will You Earn?

We believe in rewarding top talent. Letâs talk about salary once weâve had the chance to get to know you better. Rest assured, weâre generous and offer above-market pay for the right person. If you bring the skills and experience, weâll make sure the compensation reflects that.

Youâll also enjoy the following benefits:

- Monthly team events and activities
- Weekly team lunches
- Casual dress code
- Incredible dog friendly, Yaletown office one block from SkyTrain
- Remote working is okay with us too.
And above all, youâll join a team that youâll never want to leave. Culture is everything to us. Yes, we work extremely hard to change as many peopleâs lives as possible. But we know how to have fun and reward ourselves too.

How To Apply

So, do you have what it takes to become the next member of team AlgaeCal?

Job opportunities like this donât come along often, and weâve got a lot to offer our successful applicant. So, to make sure our future Associate Data Scientist is the real-deal, will be a great fit, and will thrive at AlgaeCal, we ask a little more than your run-of-the-mill job application:

If this sounds like a position for you, please respond to this advertisement with your resume and cover letter. Please, read carefully:

1. Write a cover letter addressing:

- Why are you the best Associate Data Scientist for this role? Give quantifiable examples of related achievements.
- Describe why you fit perfectly with our values. Read them here: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1deCCJZ6tiDiOSlr_W0UdCuM_V_ahzPBs/view
- What's the toughest challenge youâve ever overcome in your life? How did you overcome it?
- What are the last three books youâve read?
- What do you do for fun?
2. Explain what youâre doing now for a job:

- If you donât have one, explain why.
- If you have one, explain why youâre looking elsewhere.
3. Upload your cover letter and resume

- Ensure that your cover letter and resume are saved and sent as one file.
Yes, our hiring process is challenging, but itâs our way of selecting the best--and your way of ensuring your AlgaeCal teammates are tops.

Click the âApply Nowâ button on this page and upload your cover letter and resume.

***Note: Please include your cover letter WITH your resume in one document. Applications without a cover letter will not be read!***

We are looking to hire as soon as we find the right person, so act quickly and you can also expect a prompt response.

Please mention the word **EARNESTNESS** and tag RMTM1LjExOS4zOC40OQ== when applying to show you read the job post completely (#RMTM1LjExOS4zOC40OQ==). This is a beta feature to avoid spam applicants. Companies can search these words to find applicants that read this and see they're human.

title: Software Development Engineer II (Remote @ Colombia)
description:
Headquarters: Remote @ Colombia

About the role: 

The OfferUp Connect team builds the moments that turn a listing into a sale. Every chat between buyers and sellers, every offer notification, and every saved-search alert runs through services we own, from messaging and notifications to location, meetups, and the subscriptions sellers pay for. We run high-volume Java microservices and streaming pipelines, integrate with partners like Braze, Amazon Pinpoint, Apple, and Google, and use experimentation to decide what ships.

We also take on high-visibility work beyond our domain. Connect built OfferUp's video infrastructure for listing videos and LLM-powered catalog enrichment on Amazon Bedrock, both company priorities that changed what buyers see every day. The roadmap is wide open for someone who wants to help shape it.

As a Software Development Engineer II, you'll own features from concept to rollout: designing and writing well-tested code, launching experiments, and measuring results with Product, Design, and Data partners. You'll raise the quality of the code around you and get the chance to join the next project like video or catalog enrichment.

Here’s more of what you will get to do: 

- Design, build, and deploy backend services and event-driven pipelines for messaging, notifications, location, and subscriptions

- Improve the reliability, latency, and delivery rates of high-volume messaging and notification systems, including retries, rate limiting, and frequency capping

- Integrate with and operate third-party platforms such as Braze, Amazon Pinpoint, Apple and Google push services, and app store billing

- Own features end-to-end: plan, design, develop, deploy, measure, and iterate

- Break down complex engineering problems into achievable tasks and deliver them within committed timeframes

- Work collaboratively with cross-functional teams (Product, Design, Data Science, Marketing, and iOS, Android, and web engineers) to design and implement new features

- Contribute to A/B tests and use experimentation results to decide what ships

- Actively participate in code reviews and enforce good patterns, testing, and edge-case handling

- Coach and mentor junior team members, new hires, and interns

- Create shared components, utilities, and services that improve team velocity across the stack

- Maintain and improve the runbooks, alerting, and monitoring for the features you ship

- Participate in a reasonable on-call rotation with the rest of the team

- Use AI coding tools (Claude Code, Gemini, and similar) to increase your daily development velocity and code quality

- Become a subject matter expert in one or more of the team's sub-domains: messaging, notifications and campaigns, location, or subscriptions and promotions

You’ll thrive in this role if you have: 

- 2+ years of professional software engineering experience

- Demonstrated ability to own the delivery of multiple features end-to-end (plan, design, develop, and deploy) with high efficiency, including breaking down engineering problems into achievable tasks

- Strong coding skills in Java, with a working understanding of microservices and distributed-systems fundamentals

- Good knowledge of data structures and object-oriented design

- Working knowledge of asynchronous, event-driven systems (queues, pub/sub, or streams), including retries and idempotent processing

- Hands-on experience using AI coding tools (Claude Code or similar) in a real engineering workflow, and a point of view on when they help and when they don't

- A habit of following good coding patterns, writing appropriate tests, considering trade-offs, and seeking out edge cases

- Comfortable giving and receiving feedback in code reviews

- A bias toward shipping, learning from production, and iterating quickly

- An insatiable desire and ability to learn

- BS or MS in Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience

Helpful, but not required: 

- Fluency in another modern object-oriented programming language

- Experience with TypeScript and Node.js

- Experience with Agile development

- Experience building and integrating with REST APIs

- Experience with AWS services such as DynamoDB, SQS, SNS, Lambda, and ElastiCache (Redis)

- Experience with notification and engagement platforms (Braze, Amazon Pinpoint, APNs, FCM) or in-app subscription billing (App Store, Google Play)

- Experience with stream processing frameworks such as Apache Flink or Kafka Streams

- Experience with A/B testing platforms (Statsig, LaunchDarkly, Optimizely) and analytics warehouses (BigQuery, Snowflake)

- Experience consuming or integrating LLM-based APIs (e.g., Bedrock, Vertex AI, OpenAI)

- Familiarity with Kubernetes, Helm, and CI/CD pipelines

title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer, LLM Inference Optimization
description:
About Nebius: 

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

Role Summary

Nebius Token Factory is building production-grade inference for open-source, customer, and internally optimized models. This role owns the path from model artifact to fast, reliable, cost-efficient endpoint. The work sits at the intersection of model internals, inference engines, serving architecture, benchmarking, and production deployment.

What You Will Do

- 
Own a platform-level optimization pillar such as quantization, speculative decoding, KV -cache optimization, engine selection, or long-context serving.

- 
Create reusable evaluation, benchmarking, and rollout frameworks across multiple model families.

- 
Provide technical direction to MLEs, Applied Scientists, GPU kernel engineers, and infrastructure engineers on shared performance goals.

- 
Optimize LLM and VLM endpoints for latency, throughput, memory efficiency, GPU utilization, quality, and cost per token.

- 
Deploy, configure, benchmark, and extend inference engines such as vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, Triton Inference Server, NVIDIA Dynamo, or similar systems.

- 
Build and productionize model-compression workflows, including quantization, quantization-aware training, distillation, low-bit serving, and accuracy recovery.

- 
Implement or integrate speculative decoding, draft-model approaches, KV -cache optimization, prefix caching, chunked prefill, continuous batching, and disaggregated prefill/decode serving.

- 
Build reproducible benchmark harnesses for TTFT , TPOT , tokens per second per GPU, p95/p99 latency, GPU memory, reliability, and cost per token.

- 
Partner with GPU kernel engineers and platform engineers to diagnose bottlenecks across model code, kernels, runtime, scheduler, gateway, and cluster layers.

- 
Write clear design docs, performance reports, rollout plans, and customer-facing technical explanations.

Required Qualifications

- 
Strong Python and PyTorch engineering skills.

- 
Hands-on experience deploying or optimizing LLM, VLM , or high-throughput transformer inference systems.

- 
Practical knowledge of at least one modern inference stack such as vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, Triton Inference Server, NVIDIA Dynamo, Ray Serve, KServe, or equivalent internal systems.

- 
Strong understanding of transformer inference bottlenecks, including KV cache, attention, memory bandwidth, batching, parallelism, and long-context serving.

- 
Ability to reason quantitatively about latency, throughput, quality, utilization, and cost tradeoffs.

- 
Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with research, kernel, infrastructure, product, and customer teams.

Preferred Qualifications

- 
Experience with quantization-aware training, post-training quantization, FP8 , INT8 , INT4 , NVFP4 , MXFP4 , AWQ , GPTQ , SmoothQuant, or related techniques.

- 
Experience with distillation, speculative decoding, EAGLE, Medusa, multi-token prediction, or other inference acceleration methods.

- 
Experience with agentic workloads, including tool calling, structured outputs, streaming APIs, high concurrency, and multi-step orchestration.

- 
CUDA or Triton familiarity, even if the role is not primarily a kernel-engineering role.

- 
Open-source contributions to vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, FlashInfer, LMCache, PyTorch, Triton, Ray, KServe, or related projects.

Benefits & Perks: 

- Competitive compensation

- Career growth and learning opportunities

- Flexibility and ownership

- Collaborative and innovative culture

- Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects

- International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius: 

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI 

Equal Opportunity Statement: 

Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace and to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Applicants must be authorized to work in the country in which they apply and will be required to provide proof of employment eligibility as a condition of hire.

https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/ditto https://docs.ditto.live/home/about-ditto I've been obsessed with CRDTs since I first saw them at Strange Loop years ago, and I still can't quite believe I now get to work on them for a living — in some of the most challenging environments there are: disconnected, degraded, contested, out where the cloud isn't. If that's your kind of problem, come build with us. Ditto is the edge-native data platform that keeps distributed systems in sync when the network doesn't cooperate — an offline-first, CRDT-based layer syncing any device (phone, vehicle, sensor, server) over Bluetooth LE, P2P Wi-Fi, LAN, and tactical radio, with or without connectivity. Same core, commercial to defense; operationally deployed and network-agnostic. The problems are the fun kind: conflict-free replication with no server and no synchronized clock, multi-transport routing that never drops the connection, moving a coherent picture over links as thin as an HF radio shot, and human-in-the-loop robotics/autonomy where a detection may have to be physically carried by a moving node. Concept to field in days, not months. Most roles are open to anyone authorized to work in the U.S.; Public Sector and forward-deployed roles require U.S. person status. Remote in the U.S. (hubs: Atlanta, Austin, SF, Seattle) unless noted. - Stack: PHP 8.1 (Legacy) → Symfony · jQuery/Vanilla-JS → React · MySQL/MariaDB, SingleStore · Git, CI/CD

Unser Kernprodukt Konsentas ist über viele Jahre gewachsen, und das sieht man dem Code an. Das Backend läuft auf PHP 8.1 ohne Framework. Im Frontend stehen jQuery und Vanilla-JS neben React, und automatisierte Tests gibt es bisher wenige.

Wohin es gehen soll, ist klar: Das Backend wird schrittweise auf Symfony umgestellt, das Frontend auf React vereinheitlicht. Bis Ende 2027 soll die Migration abgeschlossen sein. Was dafür fehlt, ist kein Plan, sondern Kapazität.

- Legacy-Module bei laufendem Betrieb schrittweise durch Symfony-Services und React-Oberflächen ersetzen

- Erfahrung: etwa 4–5 Jahre in der professionellen Softwareentwicklung (ein Richtwert, keine harte Grenze)

- PHP: fundierte Kenntnisse in modernem PHP 8.x mit objektorientierter Architektur, etwa Dependency Injection, Interfaces und SOLID

title: MixRank (YC S11) | Software Engineers | 100% Remote (Global) | Full-Time
description:
MixRank (YC S11) | Software Engineers | 100% Remote (Global) | Full-Time
MixRank processes petabytes of data every month through web crawling. Hundreds of customers use our data products, including Google, Amazon, Facebook, Intel, and Adobe, across industries such as finance, recruiting, sales, marketing, and security. We’re a fully remote company with a global footprint across 20+ countries. We’re growing, profitable, employee-owned, and have no dependence on outside funding. Applicants from all geographies and backgrounds are welcome. We’re looking for passionate individuals for whom programming is not just a job, but something they genuinely love to do. We’re obsessed with computers, programming, big data, databases, compilers, hardware, math, data science, and the internet. Does this sound like you? Please apply to join our team. Our codebase is friendly to new contributors. You’ll have a fully functional development environment within hours through full automation and will be pushing commits on your first day. Deployments to production happen multiple times per day and finish in under two minutes.Effectively all of our codebase is written in Python, Rust, SQL, JavaScript/TypeScript, and Nix. The core technologies you’ll need familiarity with to be productive are Python, PostgreSQL, Linux, and Git. We operate at a larger scale than typical startups. We run two datacenters with high-performance servers we’ve built ourselves, capable of handling the volumes of data we process. We’ve implemented our own distributed file system, perform full-scale web crawls, and download and run static analysis on the entire universe of published Android APKs and iOS IPAs. Unlike a typical startup where you might spend half your time in meetings and the other half fixing Jira tickets, at MixRank you’ll challenge yourself with difficult technical problems that help you grow as an individual. We’re continuously hiring for the positions below; these aren’t singular roles that close once filled. Our philosophy is that the candidate is more important than the position. For each new member of the team, we design a custom role and responsibilities around their interests.
Other companies may create a long list of specific requirements with the expectation that you’ll exactly replace someone on the team or fit a role defined by committee. MixRank is more pragmatic: we first get excited about bringing a unique individual onto the team, then figure out the best way to support their specific talents. Junior Software Engineer - Remote (Global), Full-Time We’re looking for remote junior engineers with 0–3 years of professional software experience and 5+ years of curiosity exploring computers, programming, and technical hobby projects. This is an open-ended entry role with mentorship and diverse opportunities to work across all areas of our product: databases, distributed systems, infrastructure and tooling, data analysis, machine learning, frontend/backend web development, APIs, data mining, data modeling, and more. To stand out, please highlight what makes you unique: passion for computing, curiosity and side projects, work ethic, niche research, or anything else that shows how you think and build. Ideally, you’ve already graduated. But if you still have one or more years left of school, please feel free to apply anyway. If you’re the right fit for the team, we’ll figure out a way to accommodate your schedule. Apply here: https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/mixrank/jobs/Fnwsojk-j Software Engineer - Remote (Global), Full-Time We’re hiring generalist software engineers to work on web applications, data mining, machine learning/data science, data transformation/ETL, data modeling, database scaling, infrastructure, DevOps, and more. We’ll tailor the role to the subset of areas that best match your interests. Beneficial experience includes PostgreSQL, Python, Rust, Linux, TypeScript, Nix, frontend/backend web development, and data mining. Apply here: https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/mixrank/jobs/RXQspen-s I’m Kiran, Chief of Staff at MixRank, a fully remote data startup building go-to-market intelligence. We’re US-incorporated but hire globally, and we’re bringing on new teammates to join a fast-moving team with real ownership and impact.

description: Prior Labs | Berlin, Freiburg, NYC | ONSITE | Full-time | Technical PM, ML Infra, Research Scientist/Engineer, Backend, Full Stack We build foundation models for tabular data. Deep learning transformed text and images but mostly skipped tables, which are still the data behind most clinical trials, financial models and scientific experiments. The reason is structural: no natural sequence, no spatial structure, no shared vocabulary across datasets, so the architectures and scaling laws behind LLMs don't transfer. Our approach: pre-train a transformer on millions of synthetic datasets sampled from causal-structure priors. The whole dataset goes in as context, predictions come out in one forward pass. No per-dataset training, no hyperparameter tuning, seconds instead of hours. TabPFN v2 was published in Nature and set a new state of the art; TabPFN-3 scales to 10M rows. 4M+ downloads, 8k+ GitHub stars, in production from liquid biopsy to rail maintenance. Code: https://github.com/PriorLabs/TabPFN Since July we're an independent lab inside SAP, with more than EUR 1B committed over four years. Models stay open, research stays public, same team and offices. Roles (most can sit in any of the three offices): - Technical Product Manager, Integrations: take every model release live across SAP (AI Core to SAP Analytics Cloud), the cloud marketplaces and customer environments, and help decide which channels we build next. Reports to me, close to the code. - ML Engineer, Infrastructure: own multi-cluster GPU infra (Slurm on GCP today, multi-provider next), training performance and the tooling layer. We spend tens of millions per year on compute; you own that budget. - Research Scientist, Foundation Model: drive the model agenda - novel architectures, scaling from 10K to 1M+ samples, multimodal and causal directions. PhD plus top-venue publications, or equivalent. - Research Engineer, Foundation Model: same agenda from the engineering side. You design experiments, write the training and eval infra, and co-author the papers. - ML Engineer, Backend: design and scale the backend that serves and finetunes the models. Python/FastAPI, Terraform, K8s. - Full Stack Engineer, ML Platform: build the product end to end. TypeScript + Python, React/FastAPI/Postgres. Also hiring: Applied Scientist, Forward Deployed ML Engineer, Research Scientist (Foundational Data Science), PhD research interns, plus GTM and ops roles. 40+ people with backgrounds from Google, DeepMind, Jane Street, Goldman, G-Research, CERN. Led by Frank Hutter, advised by Bernhard Schölkopf and Yann LeCun. Comp competitive with top AI labs. All roles and applications: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/prior-labs Questions welcome in the replies here.

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
Headquarters: Remote

URL: https://www.samsara.com/ 

About the role: 

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) sits at the center of hardware, software, AI, and the physical world. The platform processes 25+ trillion data points annually from IoT sensors, cameras, and connected devices across thousands of organizations, and that dataset is compounding: it grew from 4 trillion to 25+ trillion in four years. We're still early in turning that data into the products that will define how physical operations run, and we're hiring the engineers who will build what comes next.

We're approaching ~$2B ARR growing 30%+ year over year, with 96% of our largest customers on two or more products. The fastest-growing divisions at Samsara are tackling the hardest, most ambiguous problems at the company: building new products from scratch, applying AI and ML to massive real-world datasets, and shipping capabilities that change how organizations maintain equipment, manage fleets, and run day-to-day operations. Most of this work is zero-to-one, at billion-dollar scale.

We're looking for software engineers who want to define what ships next. Leveling is broad and flexible: we're hiring from Senior through Staff+, across platform and product, and we're open to shaping scope around the right person's strengths and interests. That window won't stay open long.

This role is remote and open to candidates residing in the US. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role. 

You should apply if: 

- You want to impact the industries that run our world. The software you build will have real-world stakes: helping keep the lights on, getting food into grocery stores, keeping workers safe. What ships here isn't metrics on a dashboard. It shows up on the loading dock, the job site, and the dispatch floor.

- You want to build, not maintain. Samsara is in full growth mode. We're building new systems from scratch, not babysitting old ones. You'd own entire problem spaces end to end, with the autonomy to set direction from day one.

- You want to work where AI meets the physical world. Samsara has spent a decade building the largest proprietary dataset for physical operations. More connected assets generate more data, more data trains better models, better models drive more value, and more value wins more assets. The market and the opportunity here are what set us apart, not just the models.

- You believe customers are more than a number. Samsara engineers have a rare closeness to end users. You'll participate in customer interviews, collaborate with product managers and customer success, and use that context to build products that solve real problems operators face every day.

- You have the curiosity and drive to figure it out. We're looking for people who take pride in their work and get things done at all costs. The engineers who thrive here don't wait to be told what to build. They define it, ship it, and own the outcome. The rate-limiting step on our teams isn't tooling or process. It's ambition.

In this role, you will: 

- Take ownership of technically complex, mission-critical areas and run with them. We want to point you in a direction and show up to the demo meeting impressed, not spend our weeks managing the details.

- Define and drive technical strategy for new products and platform capabilities, from backend services and APIs to the customer-facing UI.

- Design and ship full-stack features end to end. You'll work across backend, frontend, and potentially mobile to deliver AI-powered products that solve real operational problems.

- Partner with product, design, and customer-facing teams to translate ambiguous, real-world problems into clear technical plans and measurable outcomes.

- Build and scale the systems behind AI-driven products, including data ingestion, APIs, and the workflows that put intelligence into the hands of operators.

- Raise the bar for the engineers around you through code reviews, design reviews, technical mentorship, and by setting a standard for quality, velocity, and craft.

- Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role: 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

- 8+ years of experience in software design and development, including building and operating production systems at scale.

- Strong full-stack fundamentals. You're comfortable working across backend services, APIs, and frontend (web or mobile) to ship complete products.

- Proficiency in modern languages and frameworks (Go, Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, React, or similar).

- Demonstrated experience leading cross-team or cross-org projects from inception through rollout, including managing ambiguity, driving alignment, and delivering measurable impact.

- Experience building AI-powered or data-driven products. You don't need to train models, but you know how to take AI capabilities and turn them into products customers love.

- Strong communication skills and the ability to translate between technical and non-technical stakeholders.

- A track record of building: zero-to-one products, systems you left in a meaningfully better place, or hard problems you refused to let stay unsolved.

An ideal candidate also has: 

- Experience shipping AI-powered features in production, whether that's LLM-based products, agentic workflows, recommendation systems, or other customer-facing AI.

- Comfort with modern AI-augmented development workflows (Cursor, LLMs, etc.) to multiply your output and accelerate delivery.

- Background working with real-world operational data (telematics, sensor data, work orders, inspections) or a strong interest in learning the domain.

- A proven track record of mentoring senior engineers and influencing engineering culture, standards, and best practices beyond a single team.

- Side projects, open-source contributions, or other signals of curiosity and drive outside the scope of your day job.

The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role is also eligible for an initial RSU grant with no vesting cliff, and ongoing refresh opportunities tied to performance, subject to plan terms and conditions. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual Base Salary

$162,400 — $290,000 USD

Total Rewards 

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. About Supabase 


Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.



About the role


We're looking for an engineer to drive the evolution of OrioleDB and its collaboration with the upstream PostgreSQL community. OrioleDB is a next-generation storage engine for PostgreSQL, and this role sits at the intersection of database internals, open source community work, and Supabase's managed Postgres platform.


This role requires strong working overlap with Americas time zones due to production support and on-call responsibilities.


What you'll work on 



- 
New OrioleDB features. Design and implement new capabilities in OrioleDB — for example, native index access methods (GiST, GIN, HNSW for pgvector), disaster recovery tooling, and other storage-engine-level features that expand what OrioleDB can do.




- 
Stability. Strengthen OrioleDB's reliability through deeper test coverage, fault injection, crash and recovery testing, and improvements to CI infrastructure. Ensure regressions are caught early and that OrioleDB behaves predictably under stress, replication, and failure scenarios.




- 
Upstream collaboration. Contribute changes directly to PostgreSQL core. Part of OrioleDB lives as a patch on top of PostgreSQL — moving the right pieces upstream shrinks what we maintain ourselves and benefits the wider community. This happens through PostgreSQL's open development process: the pgsql-hackers mailing list, public code review, and commitfests.




- 
Supabase integration. Work with Supabase's Postgres team to ensure OrioleDB fits naturally into Supabase's managed offering and roadmap.





You Will: 



- 
Design, implement, and test new OrioleDB features and integrate them cleanly with PostgreSQL's planner, executor, and surrounding subsystems.




- 
Build out and maintain test infrastructure: regression suites, fuzzing, randomized testing, crash and recovery testing, and CI pipelines.




- 
Identify and prepare patches suitable for upstreaming to PostgreSQL core.




- 
Improve performance, resilience, monitoring, and operational tooling for production use.




- 
Debug and resolve complex issues in low-level C code, including in storage, replication, indexing, and query execution paths.




- 
Participate in design discussions, architecture reviews, and code reviews — both inside Supabase and in the PostgreSQL community.




- 
Write clear technical documentation, design notes, and upstream proposals.




- 
Contribute to troubleshooting, analyzing, supporting and maintaining OrioleDB in production deployments. This can include answering support ticket requests, an on-call rotation, and supporting our team members in troubleshooting and fixing live customer production databases.





You Are: 



- 
An existing PostgreSQL core contributor or have equivalent experience in Database internals.




- 
An expert C programmer with 8+ years of production experience with focus on low-level systems programming




- 
Deeply familiar with PostgreSQL’s codebase, build system, and extension APIs.




- 
Have experience designing or implementing database storage engines, index structures, or query execution components.




- 
Comfortable contributing to community‑driven, upstream open source projects.




- 
Proficient in debugging and profiling complex C code in a database context.




- 
Able to write clear technical documentation and explain design trade‑offs.




- 
A strong communicator, committed to an open and collaborative development process.





What We Offer 



- 
Fully Remote 


We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.




-

Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.




- 
Tech Allowance 


Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.




- 
Health Benefits 


Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.




- 
Annual Off-Sites 


Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.




- 
Flexible Work 


We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.




- 
Professional Development 


Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.






About the Team 


Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.



- 
~400 team members




- 
60+ countries




- 
20+ languages spoken




- 
Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)




- 
540,000+ community members

description: Tower (tower.dev) | Senior Backend / Platform Engineer | London or Berlin | HYBRID | Full-time Tower is a Python-native serverless data platform. Data teams write plain Python, and we handle packaging, dependency resolution, scheduling, and execution across a serverless runtime built on Apache Iceberg. There's no clusters to manage, no YAML to write, no pipelines to rewrite to fit someone else's engine. If you've ever wanted your local Python script to just run in production at scale without a Databricks detour, that's the product. We're a small, senior team split between London and Berlin. We've built a lot of tech: Custom run dispatch service, multi-region routing, storage based on Apache Iceberg, and the runtime itself, to name a few. This is deep systems work--things like scheduling, distributed execution, and performance. We're not gluing SaaS together. Stack: Go and Rust for the platform, Python everywhere it matters, Kubernetes (EKS + Karpenter) on AWS, RDS Postgres, ElastiCache Redis, S3/Iceberg, WorkOS for auth. Looking for: * strong distributed-systems fundamentals * comfort owning a system end to end * taste for correctness under load Bonus: data-platform, query-engine, or Iceberg experience; async Rust; Kubernetes internals. Apply / questions: Email in bio — mention HN.

Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the amount of time they take to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts.
